words.enDefinition: a costing approach used for full absorption

examples.en: Our controller switched the plant to full absorption costing before the audit.
examples.zh: 审计之前，我们的财务主管把工厂改用「全部成本计算」。

examples.en: Under full absorption costing, each unit carries a share of the factory overhead.
examples.zh: 在「全部成本计算」下，每件产品都要分摊一部分制造费用。

words.enDefinition: a market in which prices are generally falling and investor confidence is low

examples.en: After three down quarters, traders finally admitted we were in a bear market.
examples.zh: 连续三个季度下跌之后，交易员们终于承认市场已进入「熊市」。

examples.en: During the bear market, our fund held cash and bought quality stocks cheaply.
examples.zh: 在「熊市」期间，我们的基金持有现金，并趁低买入了优质股票。

words.enDefinition: stocks of ending

examples.en: The grain report put ending stocks at their lowest level in five years.
examples.zh: 这份粮食报告显示，「期末库存」降到了五年来的最低点。

examples.en: Rising ending stocks pressured soybean prices all through the winter.
examples.zh: 「期末库存」不断攀升，整个冬天都在压制大豆价格。

words.enDefinition: an amount received from a customer before delivery of goods or services

examples.en: The builder recorded the deposit as an advance from customers, not revenue.
examples.zh: 承建商把这笔定金记作「顾客预付款」，而不是收入。

examples.en: We shipped early because the advance from customers covered our material costs.
examples.zh: 由于「顾客预付款」已经覆盖了材料成本，我们提前安排了发货。

words.enDefinition: the cost of engineered

examples.en: Packaging is an engineered cost, so design changes move it directly.
examples.zh: 包装属于「技术性成本」，设计一改它就会随之变动。

examples.en: The finance team treats freight per carton as an engineered cost standard.
examples.zh: 财务团队把每箱运费当作「技术性成本」标准来管理。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning advertising

examples.en: The agency drafted an advertising contract covering three summer campaigns.
examples.zh: 广告代理商起草了一份涵盖三个夏季活动的「广告合同」。

examples.en: Under the advertising contract, airtime fees are billed monthly in arrears.
examples.zh: 按照「广告合同」的约定，广告时段费用按月后付结算。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for advertising

examples.en: Marketing trimmed the advertising budget to fund the product launch instead.
examples.zh: 市场部削减了「广告预算」，把经费腾给新品发布。

examples.en: Half our advertising budget now goes to short-video platforms and live streams.
examples.zh: 如今我们一半的「广告预算」都投给了短视频平台。

words.enDefinition: export activity related to engage in

examples.en: Small workshops rarely engage in export until they win overseas certification.
examples.zh: 小型作坊往往要等到拿到海外认证后才开始「作出口贸易」。

examples.en: Two family firms engage in export of hand-woven baskets through a trading house.
examples.zh: 两家家族企业通过贸易行「作出口贸易」，销售手工编织篮。

words.enDefinition: the cost of unit operation

examples.en: Cutting changeover time lowered our unit operation cost by twelve percent.
examples.zh: 缩短换型时间让我们的「单位经营成本」下降了百分之十二。

examples.en: The plant manager posts the unit operation cost beside every production line.
examples.zh: 厂长把「单位经营(操作)成本」张贴在每条生产线旁。

words.zhGloss: 在习惯期限内支付的信用状
words.enDefinition: a letter of credit payable at a future (usance/deferred) date rather than at sight
acceptedZhAnswers: 在习惯期限内支付的信用状

examples.en: The importer opened a usance letter of credit payable ninety days after shipment.
examples.zh: 进口商开立了一张装运后九十天付款的「远期信用证」。

examples.en: Suppliers accept a usance letter of credit more readily than open account terms.
examples.zh: 相比赊账条件，供应商更愿意接受「远期信用证」。

collocations: arrange the usance letter of credit
monitor the usance letter of credit
repay the usance letter of credit

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for additional

examples.en: Customs delays added additional costs that the buyer refused to absorb.
examples.zh: 海关延误产生了「追加成本」，买方拒绝承担。

examples.en: Quote the client a firm price so no additional costs surprise them later.
examples.zh: 给客户报一个实价，免得日后冒出「追加成本」让他们措手不及。

words.enDefinition: trade activity concerning value of retail

examples.en: Monthly statistics put the value of retail trade up nine percent year on year.
examples.zh: 月度统计显示「零售贸易价值」同比增长了百分之九。

examples.en: The value of retail trade dips every February after the holiday rush.
examples.zh: 每年二月节日旺季过后，「零售贸易价值」都会回落。

words.enDefinition: the value attributed to business sale

examples.en: The broker estimated the value of business sale at two and a half million.
examples.zh: 经纪人估计这笔「商业销售价」约为二百五十万。

examples.en: Taxes are calculated on the value of business sale, including freight charges.
examples.zh: 税款按「商业销售价」计算，运费也包含在内。

collocations: prioritise the value of business sale
standardise the value of business sale
monitor the value of business sale

words.enDefinition: trade activity concerning value of wholesale

examples.en: Statistics bureau data tracks the value of wholesale trade by product group.
examples.zh: 统计局的数据按产品类别跟踪「批发贸易价值」。

examples.en: Online platforms have lifted the value of wholesale trade for farm produce.
examples.zh: 电商平台推高了农产品的「批发贸易价值」。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for distribution costs

examples.en: The distribution costs budget covers warehousing, freight, and delivery fuel.
examples.zh: 「推销成本预算」涵盖了仓储、运费和送货油费。

examples.en: Overspending the distribution costs budget triggered a review of carrier contracts.
examples.zh: 「推销成本预算」超支后，公司重新审查了承运商合同。

words.enDefinition: the cost of administration

examples.en: Sharing one reception desk cut each department's administrative cost by a fifth.
examples.zh: 共用一个前台把各部门的「管理成本」降了下来。

examples.en: Auditors flagged the administrative cost allocations between our two overseas subsidiaries.
examples.zh: 审计人员对两家子公司之间的「管理成本」分摊提出质疑。

words.enDefinition: the cost of distribution on manufacturing

examples.en: The overhead rate applies distribution on manufacturing cost of each batch.
examples.zh: 间接费用率按每批产品的制造成本进行「按制造成本分配」。

examples.en: Selling expenses are apportioned by distribution on manufacturing cost totals.
examples.zh: 销售费用是按制造成本总额「按制造成本分配」的。

collocations: estimate the distribution on manufacturing cost
allocate the distribution on manufacturing cost
cut the distribution on manufacturing cost

words.enDefinition: trade activity concerning distributive

examples.en: Distributive trade covers wholesalers, retailers, and the logistics between them.
examples.zh: 「销售网贸易」涵盖批发商、零售商以及二者之间的物流环节。

examples.en: The report links distributive trade employment to consumer spending trends.
examples.zh: 该报告把「销售网贸易」的就业情况与消费支出走势联系起来。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning distributor

examples.en: Our distributor contract grants exclusive rights for the coastal provinces.
examples.zh: 我们的「经销合同」授予了沿海省份的独家经销权。

examples.en: Terminating the distributor contract early would trigger a penalty clause.
examples.zh: 提前终止「经销合同」会触发违约金条款。

words.enDefinition: a reduction from the normal amount for distributor

examples.en: Volume orders earn a distributor discount of eight percent off list price.
examples.zh: 批量订货可享受按牌价八折的「批发折扣」。

examples.en: The distributor discount shrinks if monthly purchases fall below target.
examples.zh: 如果月采购量低于目标，「批发折扣」就会缩水。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for distribution

examples.en: Fuel prices pushed distribution costs up faster than sales grew.
examples.zh: 油价上涨令「分销成本」的增速超过了销售额的增速。

examples.en: Consolidating deliveries across brands trimmed distribution costs by a fifth.
examples.zh: 各品牌合并配送后，「分销成本」削减了五分之一。

words.enDefinition: management of unsystematized sales

examples.en: Rapid growth left the firm with unsystematized sales management and lost orders.
examples.zh: 快速扩张导致公司「销售管理缺乏系统」，订单也时有遗失。

examples.en: The consultant blamed unsystematized sales management for the missed quotas.
examples.zh: 顾问把未完成定额归咎于「非系统化的销售管理」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of adjusted acquisition

examples.en: Impairment testing restates goodwill at adjusted acquisition cost each year.
examples.zh: 减值测试每年都按「调整后取得成本」对商誉重新计价。

examples.en: Currency moves changed the adjusted acquisition cost of the foreign subsidiary.
examples.zh: 汇率变动改变了这家外国子公司的「调整后取得成本」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of administration

examples.en: Moving payroll to the cloud trimmed our administration cost noticeably.
examples.zh: 把薪酬核算搬到云端后，我们的「管理成本」明显下降。

examples.en: Grant rules cap administration cost at ten percent of project funding.
examples.zh: 资助条款规定「管理成本」不得超过项目经费的百分之十。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in administered transactions

examples.en: Electricity remains an administered price, set by the regulator each year.
examples.zh: 电价仍属于「管制价格」，由监管机构每年核定。

examples.en: Farmers lobbied hard against the administered price for seed potatoes this season.
examples.zh: 农场主游说反对「管制价格」下的种薯定价。

words.enDefinition: costs incurred for unabsorbed manufacturing

examples.en: Idle weeks left unabsorbed manufacturing expenses on the April books.
examples.zh: 停工数周使四月的账面上出现了「未分配制造费用」。

examples.en: The controller writes off unabsorbed manufacturing expenses against the period.
examples.zh: 财务主管将「未分配制造费用」直接计入当期损益。

words.enDefinition: a voucher supporting disbursement

examples.en: No cheque leaves the office without a signed disbursement voucher attached.
examples.zh: 没有签好的「支付凭单」，任何支票都不能开出。

examples.en: The auditor traced every payment back to its disbursement voucher.
examples.zh: 审计员把每笔付款都追溯到了对应的「支付凭单」。

words.enDefinition: a market for ultimate consumer

examples.en: We sell ingredients wholesale; the ultimate consumer market belongs to brands.
examples.zh: 我们做原料批发，「最后消费者市场」留给品牌方去做。

examples.en: Design choices differ once a product heads for the ultimate consumer market.
examples.zh: 产品一旦走向「最终消费者市场」，设计思路就完全不同了。

collocations: clear goods through the ultimate consumer market

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for unbalanced

examples.en: Councillors refused to pass an unbalanced budget before the election.
examples.zh: 议员们拒绝在大选前通过「不平衡的预算」。

examples.en: The unbalanced budget assumed borrowing that the treasurer could not arrange.
examples.zh: 这份「不平衡的预算」假设了一笔司库根本筹不到的借款。

words.enDefinition: a cost incurred for unapplied manufacturing

examples.en: Slow orders left unapplied manufacturing expense sitting in the overhead account.
examples.zh: 订单不足使「未分配的制造费用」滞留在间接费用账户里。

examples.en: We allocate unapplied manufacturing expense to cost of goods sold monthly.
examples.zh: 我们每月把「未分配的制造费用」结转到销货成本中。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in escalation transactions

examples.en: The steel supply deal uses an escalation price tied to raw material indexes.
examples.zh: 这份钢材供货协议采用与原材料指数挂钩的「逐步上升价格」。

examples.en: Buyers accepted an escalation price rather than a fixed two-year quote.
examples.zh: 买方接受了「逐步上升价格」，而不是固定两年的报价。

words.enDefinition: the cost of escapable

examples.en: Shutting the night shift removes an escapable cost of forty thousand monthly.
examples.zh: 关闭夜班可削减每月四万元的「可免成本」。

examples.en: Only escapable cost counts when we price the outsourcing offer.
examples.zh: 测算外包报价时，只把「可免成本」计算在内。

words.enDefinition: a change in market direction or trading conditions

examples.en: Old traders read the turn of the market from volume, not headlines.
examples.zh: 老交易员是通过成交量而非新闻标题来判断「市场变化」的。

examples.en: Nobody predicted the turn of the market that followed the rate cut.
examples.zh: 谁也没料到降息之后会出现那样的「市场转变」。

collocations: secure the turn of the market
visit the turn of the market
lease the turn of the market

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning turn-key

examples.en: The whole bottling line was delivered under a turn-key contract.
examples.zh: 整条灌装生产线是按「整套承包合同」交付的。

examples.en: A turn-key contract suits buyers who lack their own project engineers.
examples.zh: 对没有自有项目工程师的买方来说，「整套承包合同」很合适。

words.enDefinition: a fee or commission paid in respect of agreed agency

examples.en: We paid the agreed agency commission within thirty days of settlement.
examples.zh: 我们在结算后三十天内支付了「约定的代理佣金」。

examples.en: Any agreed agency commission above eight percent needs board sign-off.
examples.zh: 超过百分之八的「约定代理佣金」须经董事会批准。

words.enDefinition: selling activity or proceeds related to estimated profit from

examples.en: The pitch deck forecast an estimated profit from sales of two hundred million.
examples.zh: 路演材料预计「销售利润」可达两亿。

examples.en: Managers compare estimated profit from sales against actuals every quarter.
examples.zh: 管理层每季度都把「预计销售利润」与实际业绩进行对比。

words.enDefinition: an act of agricultural marketing

examples.en: The agricultural marketing act regulates how co-ops sell members' produce.
examples.zh: 这部「农业市场经营法」规范合作社销售社员农产品的方式。

examples.en: Under the agricultural marketing act, grain must pass licensed elevators.
examples.zh: 依照「农业市场经营法」，谷物必须经持牌粮仓流转。

words.enDefinition: a capital metric or concept concerning turnover of total

examples.en: Fast inventory turns lifted our turnover of total capital above industry norms.
examples.zh: 库存周转加快，使我们的「总资产周转率」高于行业平均水平。

examples.en: A falling turnover of total capital warned managers that assets sat idle.
examples.zh: 「总资产周转率」下滑，提醒管理层资产正在闲置。

collocations: calculate the turnover of total capital
compare the turnover of total capital
reduce the turnover of total capital

words.enDefinition: financial gain arising from unearned

examples.en: Prepayments booked as unearned profit until the goods actually ship.
examples.zh: 预收款在货物实际发运前记为「未实现利润」。

examples.en: The accountant separated unearned profit from revenue in the draft accounts.
examples.zh: 会计在报表初稿中把「未实现利润」与营业收入分开列示。

words.enDefinition: the cost of enterprise

examples.en: Consultants mapped every enterprise cost from payroll to parking leases.
examples.zh: 咨询顾问梳理了从工资到停车场租约的每一项「企业成本」。

examples.en: Rebates must exceed the enterprise cost of running the loyalty program.
examples.zh: 返利必须高于运营会员计划的「企业成本」。

words.enDefinition: trade activity concerning entrepot

examples.en: Singapore built much of its port wealth on entrepot trade with neighbouring countries.
examples.zh: 新加坡的港口财富很大程度上建立在「转口贸易」之上。

examples.en: Tariff changes made entrepot trade through the free zone less attractive.
examples.zh: 关税调整令经自由港区的「转口贸易」吸引力下降。

words.enDefinition: theory of entity equity

examples.en: Entity equity theory treats the firm itself as the claim holder.
examples.zh: 「企业个体权益说」把企业本身视为权益的持有者。

examples.en: Under entity equity theory, dividends are distributions of the entity's equity.
examples.zh: 按照「(企业)个体权益说」，股利是对企业个体权益的分配。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for discretionary

examples.en: Training and advertising are discretionary costs the board can trim quickly.
examples.zh: 培训和广告属于「自定的成本」，董事会可以快速削减。

examples.en: Recession planning starts by freezing discretionary costs rather than cutting headcount immediately.
examples.zh: 衰退预案先冻结「酌量性成本」，而不是先裁员。

words.enDefinition: a market for uneven

examples.en: Dealers complained about an uneven market where some lots fetched double.
examples.zh: 经销商抱怨「行情涨跌不定」，同一批货有的能卖出双倍价钱。

examples.en: An uneven market like this makes pricing new listings genuinely difficult for dealers.
examples.zh: 在「不平静的市场」里，给新上市的货定价确实很难。

collocations: clear goods through the uneven market

words.enDefinition: the cost of unexpired

examples.en: Prepaid rent is an unexpired cost until the months actually pass.
examples.zh: 预付租金在月份实际过去之前属于「未耗成本」。

examples.en: The balance sheet lists unexpired cost of insurance among current assets.
examples.zh: 资产负债表把保险的「未耗成本」列在流动资产中。

words.enDefinition: a joint venture in which partners contribute equity capital

examples.en: The two partners registered their equity joint-venture in Shanghai last autumn.
examples.zh: 双方在上海注册了一家「股权式合资经营」企业。

examples.en: Profits from the equity joint-venture are split fifty-fifty after tax each year.
examples.zh: 这家「产权式合营企业」的税后利润按五五分成。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for uncontrollable

examples.en: Managers are judged on margins, not on uncontrollable costs like rates.
examples.zh: 考核经理看的是毛利，而不是税费这类「不能控制的成本」。

examples.en: Head office absorbs uncontrollable costs such as flood damage insurance.
examples.zh: 洪水损失保险等「不可控成本」由总部承担。

words.enDefinition: a fee paid to an agent for arranging a sale or service

examples.en: The agency commission runs at five percent of the invoice value.
examples.zh: 「代理手续费」按发票金额的百分之五计收。

examples.en: Deduct the agency commission before wiring the balance to the supplier.
examples.zh: 给供应商汇余款之前，先扣掉「代理手续费」。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning agency

examples.en: Our agency contract forbids the agent from handling rival brands.
examples.zh: 我们的「代理合同」禁止代理商经营竞争品牌。

examples.en: The agency contract renews automatically each year unless cancelled before the first of March.
examples.zh: 除非三月底前解约，否则「代理合同」会自动续期。

words.enDefinition: ownership participation through an equity stake

examples.en: The supplier took equity participation instead of insisting on cash upfront.
examples.zh: 供应商没有坚持预付现金，而是选择了「参股」。

examples.en: Government funds offer equity participation to early-stage firms in the clean-energy sector.
examples.zh: 政府基金以「股权参与」的方式支持早期清洁能源企业。

words.enDefinition: costs incurred for under-applied manufacturing

examples.en: August's under-applied manufacturing expenses went straight to cost of sales.
examples.zh: 八月的「少分配制造费用」直接结转进了销售成本。

examples.en: Under-applied manufacturing expenses usually signal that our overhead rates need urgent revising.
examples.zh: 出现「少分配制造费用」说明分配率需要修订了。

words.enDefinition: indirect costs related to under-applied manufacturing

examples.en: We investigate under-applied manufacturing overhead before closing the books for the quarter.
examples.zh: 结账前我们会先核查「少分配制造费用」的成因。

examples.en: Rising under-applied manufacturing overhead pointed to idle capacity across the whole plant.
examples.zh: 「少分配制造费用」不断增加，暴露出产能闲置的问题。

words.enDefinition: an annuity linked to equity assets or returns

examples.en: Her pension buys an equity annuity whose payments track fund returns.
examples.zh: 她的养老金购买了一份收益随基金回报浮动的「资产年金」。

examples.en: An equity annuity protects against inflation better than a fixed one.
examples.zh: 与固定年金相比，「资产年金」抵御通胀的能力更强。

words.enDefinition: business activity related to wholesale

examples.en: His father ran a wholesale business supplying village grocery shops.
examples.zh: 他父亲做「批发业」，供货给乡村的杂货小店。

examples.en: Margins in the wholesale business are thin but volumes are huge.
examples.zh: 「批发业」利润率虽薄，但走量极大。

words.enDefinition: the cost of wholesale

examples.en: We price retail at double the wholesale cost of each carton.
examples.zh: 我们的零售价按每箱「批发成本」的一倍定价。

examples.en: Freight surcharges raised the wholesale cost of imported flour sharply.
examples.zh: 运费附加费大幅抬高了进口面粉的「批发成本」。

words.enDefinition: the ability to enter or sell into markets

examples.en: Certification gives small growers access to markets they could never reach alone.
examples.zh: 认证让小种植户获得了单靠自己无法企及的「市场准入」。

examples.en: Trade talks stalled over access to markets for dairy exports.
examples.zh: 贸易谈判因奶制品出口的「进入市场」问题陷入僵局。

words.enDefinition: an agency dealing with wholesale

examples.en: A Copenhagen wholesale agency has represented our cheeses across Scandinavia for years.
examples.zh: 哥本哈根的一家「批发代理商」代理我们的奶酪销往北欧。

examples.en: The wholesale agency takes orders but never holds stock itself.
examples.zh: 这家「批发代理所」只接订单，自身并不囤货。

words.enDefinition: financial gain arising from early

examples.en: Cutting the launch price delayed early profit but widened the customer base.
examples.zh: 下调上市价延缓了「早期利润」，却扩大了客户群。

examples.en: Investors accepted modest early profit in exchange for faster expansion.
examples.zh: 投资人接受较少的「早期利润」，以换取更快的扩张。

words.enDefinition: the cost of absolute fixed

examples.en: Insurance premiums are an absolute fixed cost even if the plant stands idle.
examples.zh: 即使工厂停工，保险费也是一笔「纯粹固定成本」。

examples.en: Lease payments represent the absolute fixed cost of occupying the warehouse.
examples.zh: 仓库租金是占用库房产生的「纯粹固定成本」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of absolute

examples.en: Per-unit absolute cost fell once the second kiln came online.
examples.zh: 第二座窑炉投产后，单位「绝对成本」降了下来。

examples.en: Compare the absolute cost of both options before judging which plant runs efficiently.
examples.zh: 评估效率之前，先比较各工厂的「绝对成本」。

words.enDefinition: an unconditional order requiring payment

examples.en: A bill of exchange is an absolute order to pay, with no conditions attached.
examples.zh: 汇票是一份「无条件支付命令」，不得附加任何条件。

examples.en: The court upheld the draft as an absolute order to pay the holder.
examples.zh: 法院认定这张票据是对持票人的「无条件支付命令」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of absorbed

examples.en: Direct labour is an absorbed cost within each product's unit price.
examples.zh: 直接人工是计入单位产品价格的「已分配成本」。

examples.en: The margin looks thin until absorbed cost is separated from markups.
examples.zh: 在把「已分配(吸收)的成本」与加成分开之前，毛利看起来都很薄。

words.enDefinition: manufacturing overhead allocated to units produced using a predetermined overhead rate

examples.en: Absorbed manufacturing overhead rose steadily with every additional machine hour we booked.
examples.zh: 机器工时越多，计入的「已分配制造费用」就越多。

examples.en: Compare absorbed manufacturing overhead with actual spend at year end.
examples.zh: 年末要把「已分配制造费用」与实际发生额进行比较。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for drafted

examples.en: The drafted budget still assumes fuel prices stay near current levels.
examples.zh: 这份「拟定预算」仍假设油价维持在当前水平附近。

examples.en: Department heads challenged several figures in the drafted budget during Monday's review.
examples.zh: 部门主管对「拟定预算」中的几个数字提出了异议。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for domestic supply

examples.en: Dumping cases often hinge on the domestic supply price back home.
examples.zh: 倾销案件往往取决于其本国的「国内供应价格」。

examples.en: Export quotes must exceed the domestic supply price by a fair margin.
examples.zh: 出口报价必须比「国内供应价格」高出合理幅度。

words.enDefinition: prices charged in domestic market transactions

examples.en: Domestic market prices for steel climbed after the export duty ended.
examples.zh: 出口关税取消后，钢材的「国内市场价格」一路攀升。

examples.en: The subsidy insulates farmers whenever domestic market prices collapse after a bumper harvest.
examples.zh: 当「国内市场价格」崩跌时，补贴能为农户托底。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for dual market

examples.en: A dual market price lets villagers buy fuel cheaper than exporters pay.
examples.zh: 「双重市场价格」让村民买油比出口商更便宜。

examples.en: Critics argue the dual market price distorts investment decisions across the whole sector.
examples.zh: 批评者认为「双重市场价格」扭曲了投资决策。

words.zhGloss: 缓慢(逐渐)销售的管理方式
words.enDefinition: management of drifting sales
acceptedZhAnswers: 缓慢(逐渐)销售的管理方式

examples.en: Without clear targets, the branch drifted into drifting sales management within months.
examples.zh: 没有目标，分店的销售便滑向了「缓慢松散的销售管理方式」。

examples.en: The new VP replaced drifting sales management with weekly pipeline reviews.
examples.zh: 新任副总裁用每周销售漏斗例会取代了「拖沓的销售管理方式」。

words.enDefinition: the formal act of settling a dispute by arbitration

examples.en: The chamber's act of arbitration spells out how disputes are referred.
examples.zh: 商会的「仲裁条例」规定了争议提交仲裁的程序。

examples.en: Both parties accepted the act of arbitration written into the charter party.
examples.zh: 双方都接受了租船合同中订明的「仲裁条例」。

words.enDefinition: a letter of credit that requires stipulated commercial/shipping documents before payment

examples.en: Payment is by documentary credit confirmed by a first-class bank.
examples.zh: 付款采用由一流银行保兑的「押汇信用状」。

examples.en: The documentary credit calls for a full set of clean bills of lading.
examples.zh: 这份「跟单信用证」要求提交全套清洁提单。

words.enDefinition: the cost of effective cash

examples.en: After subsidies, the effective cash cost of the vaccine dose is under a dollar.
examples.zh: 扣除补贴后，每剂疫苗的「实际现金成本」不到一美元。

examples.en: Leases hide repayments that raise the effective cash cost of the truck.
examples.zh: 租赁把还款藏了起来，实际抬高了卡车的「实际现金成本」。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for variable factory overhead

examples.en: Variable factory overhead costs climb sharply whenever overtime shifts begin on the line.
examples.zh: 只要开加班班次，「变动的工厂制造费用」就会上升。

examples.en: We flex the budget for variable factory overhead costs with output.
examples.zh: 「变动工厂制造费用」的预算随产量弹性调整。

words.enDefinition: a financial ratio that relates variable cost

examples.en: A lower variable cost ratio leaves more margin to cover rent.
examples.zh: 「可变成本比率」越低，用于覆盖租金的毛利就越多。

examples.en: The lender checked our variable cost ratio before extending credit.
examples.zh: 放贷之前，银行核查了我们的「可变成本(或费用)比率」。

words.enDefinition: additional margin paid or received as a position is marked to market

examples.en: Futures losses today mean variation margin is due tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 今日期货亏损，「价格变动押金」明早就要补缴。

examples.en: The clearing house swept variation margin from the broker's account daily.
examples.zh: 结算所每天从经纪商账户划收「变动保证金」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of variation from budgeted

examples.en: Any variation from budgeted cost above five percent needs a written reason.
examples.zh: 「偏离预算的成本差异」一旦超过百分之五，就必须提交书面说明。

examples.en: The report explains each variation from budgeted cost by department.
examples.zh: 报告逐部门解释了「偏离预算的成本差异」。

collocations: estimate the variation from budgeted cost
allocate the variation from budgeted cost
cut the variation from budgeted cost

words.enDefinition: costs incurred for variable manufacturing overhead

examples.en: Utilities dominate our variable manufacturing overhead expenses during the summer cooling months.
examples.zh: 夏季的「可变制造费用」以水电费为大头。

examples.en: Variable manufacturing overhead expenses flex neatly with machine hours in our model.
examples.zh: 「变动制造费用」随机器工时同步起伏。

collocations: recover the variable manufacturing overhead expenses
allocate the variable manufacturing overhead expenses
defer the variable manufacturing overhead expenses

words.zhGloss: 可变间接费用价格差异
words.enDefinition: the difference between planned and actual variable overhead price
acceptedZhAnswers: 可变间接费用价格差异

examples.en: A favourable variable overhead price variance came from cheaper power tariffs.
examples.zh: 电价下调带来了「可变间接费用价格差异」的有利结果。

examples.en: The variable overhead price variance stayed adverse after the supplier switch.
examples.zh: 更换供应商后，「变动制造费用价格差异」仍为不利。

words.enDefinition: the cost of activity

examples.en: Setting up machines is an activity cost we now charge to each batch.
examples.zh: 机器换型是一项「作业成本」，如今直接计入每批次。

examples.en: The team traced every activity cost before redesigning the process.
examples.zh: 团队在重设计流程前先梳理了每项「作业成本」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for actual selling

examples.en: Discounts dragged the actual selling price below the catalogue figure.
examples.zh: 折扣使「实际销售价格」跌破了目录价。

examples.en: We recompute margin weekly using the actual selling price per invoice.
examples.zh: 我们每周按每张发票的「实际售价」重新计算毛利。

words.enDefinition: a certificate documenting warehousekeeper's

examples.en: The bank released funds against the warehousekeeper's certificate for the cocoa.
examples.zh: 银行凭可可豆的「仓库管理人证明」放款。

examples.en: A warehousekeeper's certificate accompanies every lot stored at the depot.
examples.zh: 每批入库货物都随附一份「仓库管理人证明」。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in warehouse transactions

examples.en: The warehouse price includes humidity control for the paper stock.
examples.zh: 「仓库价格」包含纸张存货的湿度控制费用。

examples.en: Compare the warehouse price per pallet across the three depots.
examples.zh: 把三个仓库的每托盘「仓储价格」比较一下。

words.enDefinition: a person who manages or works in a warehouse

examples.en: The warehouse man forklifted the pallets onto the export truck himself.
examples.zh: 这位「仓库管理员」亲自用叉车把托盘装上出口货车。

examples.en: A trusted warehouse man signs off every discrepancy on the tally sheet.
examples.zh: 可靠的「仓库管理员」会在理货单上签认每一处差异。

words.enDefinition: a person responsible for keeping a warehouse

examples.en: Our warehouse keeper runs monthly cycle counts without being asked.
examples.zh: 我们的「仓库管理员」不用吩咐就自觉执行每月循环盘点。

examples.en: The warehouse keeper refused the delivery because seals were broken.
examples.zh: 由于封条破损，「仓库管理员」拒收了那批货。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with warehouse

examples.en: We chose a warehouse company with bonded facilities near the port.
examples.zh: 我们选了一家在港口附近设有保税设施的「仓储公司」。

examples.en: The warehouse company insures stored goods against flood damage without extra paperwork.
examples.zh: 这家「仓库公司」自动为货物投保水灾损失。

words.enDefinition: an amount due from others in respect of accrued

examples.en: Interest earned but unbilled sits as an accrued receivable at month end.
examples.zh: 已赚取但未开票的利息在月末挂账为「应计应收款」。

examples.en: The team clears accrued receivable balances once invoices are issued.
examples.zh: 发票开出后，团队即核销相应的「应计应收款」。

words.enDefinition: a quota for voluntary export

examples.en: Exporters agreed to a voluntary export quota to head off harsher tariffs.
examples.zh: 出口商接受「自愿」出口配额，以免招致更重的关税。

examples.en: The voluntary export quota caps car shipments at two hundred thousand units.
examples.zh: 这项「自愿出口配额」把汽车出口量限制在二十万辆以内。

collocations: comply with the voluntary export quota

words.enDefinition: an agent acting for accredited

examples.en: Only an accredited agent may file declarations with the customs bureau.
examples.zh: 只有「授权代理人」才能向海关申报。

examples.en: We hired an accredited agent in Brussels to handle the compliance filings.
examples.zh: 我们在布鲁塞尔聘请了一位「授权代理人」处理合规申报。

words.enDefinition: an amount due from others in respect of accrued commission

examples.en: Deals closed but unpaid leave an accrued commission receivable on the books.
examples.zh: 已成交未收款的交易在账上形成「应计未收手续费(佣金)」。

examples.en: The accrued commission receivable aged past ninety days and was reserved.
examples.zh: 「应计未收佣金」账龄超过九十天，已计提准备。

words.enDefinition: a market for falling

examples.en: In a falling market, buyers stall and wait for the next quote.
examples.zh: 「行情下跌」时，买方往往按兵不动，等下一次报价。

examples.en: Producers held cotton back from sale despite the falling market this quarter.
examples.zh: 尽管「市场价格下跌」，生产者仍惜售棉花。

words.enDefinition: an appraisal of the value or condition of a business

examples.en: The divorce settlement required an independent appraisal of business value.
examples.zh: 离婚财产分割需要对「企业估价」进行独立评估。

examples.en: An appraisal of business worth considers goodwill, not just equipment.
examples.zh: 「商业(企业)估价」要考虑商誉，而不只是设备。

words.enDefinition: financial gain arising from surplus

examples.en: Valuers capitalise surplus profit to estimate goodwill for the bakery chain.
examples.zh: 评估师对「剩余利润」进行资本化，以估算面包连锁的商誉。

examples.en: Returns above the normal rate count as surplus profit in the valuation.
examples.zh: 在估值中，高于正常回报的部分计入「超额利润」。

words.enDefinition: a fee or commission paid in respect of switching

examples.en: Brokers earn a switching commission each time clients change funds.
examples.zh: 客户每次转换基金，经纪人都能赚取「转手(转换)佣金」。

examples.en: Regulators capped the switching commission at one percent to curb churning.
examples.zh: 监管机构对「转换佣金」设了上限，以遏制频繁倒仓。

words.enDefinition: revenue arising from extraordinary

examples.en: Selling the old depot produced extraordinary revenue, not operating income.
examples.zh: 出售旧仓库带来的是「非常收入」，而非经营收入。

examples.en: Analysts stripped extraordinary revenue out of the earnings comparison for fairness.
examples.zh: 分析师在盈利对比中剔除了「非常收入」。

words.enDefinition: a summary of factory costs by responsibility centre

examples.en: The plant meeting opens with the factory cost responsibility summary.
examples.zh: 工厂例会先过一遍「责任制造成本汇总表」。

examples.en: Each shift supervisor signs the factory cost responsibility summary monthly.
examples.zh: 各班组长每月在「工厂责任成本汇总表」上签字确认。

collocations: prepare the factory cost responsibility summary
review the factory cost responsibility summary
circulate the factory cost responsibility summary

words.enDefinition: a schedule or sheet presenting factory cost

examples.en: The factory cost sheet breaks down each order's materials, labour, and overhead.
examples.zh: 「制造成本表」把每张订单的材料、人工和间接费用逐项列明。

examples.en: Check the factory cost sheet line by line before approving the quotation.
examples.zh: 批准报价前先核对「制造成本单」。

words.enDefinition: a document presenting information about factory departmental cost

examples.en: Every Monday the plant emails the factory departmental cost report to controllers.
examples.zh: 每周一，工厂都会把「部门制造成本报告」电邮给各控制会计。

examples.en: Line 3's repairs jumped out in this month's factory departmental cost report.
examples.zh: 在本月的「部门制造成本报告」里，三号车间的维修费格外显眼。

collocations: draft the factory departmental cost report
circulate the factory departmental cost report
amend the factory departmental cost report

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for developing

examples.en: Developing costs for the electric scooter prototype now exceed one million.
examples.zh: 电动滑板车样机的「开发成本」目前已超过一百万元。

examples.en: We charge developing costs against the project until the pilot line runs.
examples.zh: 在试产线投产之前，「发展成本」全部计入该项目。

words.enDefinition: revenue arising from anticipated

examples.en: Booking anticipated revenue before delivery landed the startup in trouble.
examples.zh: 在交付前就确认「预计收入」，让这家初创公司惹上了麻烦。

examples.en: Cash flow forecasts rest on anticipated revenue from signed contracts only.
examples.zh: 现金流预测只基于已签合同的「预计收入」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of anticipated

examples.en: The tender requires every anticipated cost to be itemised on form B.
examples.zh: 投标要求把每项「预计成本」在B表上逐项列明。

examples.en: Legal fees were an anticipated cost nobody budgeted for realistically.
examples.zh: 律师费是一笔谁都没想到的「预计成本」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for tank cession

examples.en: The refinery quotes a tank cession price for fuel delivered into the depot.
examples.zh: 炼油厂对送入油库的燃料报出「油库交货价格」。

examples.en: Our contract switches from tank cession price to pipeline tariff in July.
examples.zh: 七月起，我们的合同将从「油库交货价格」改为管道运价结算。

words.enDefinition: selling activity or proceeds related to target return on

examples.en: Pricing software nudges quotes until each deal hits our target return on sales.
examples.zh: 定价软件会不断调整报价，直到每笔订单达到「目标销售利润」。

examples.en: The board set a target return on sales of eighteen percent for 2027.
examples.zh: 董事会把2027年的「目标销售利润率」定为百分之十八。

collocations: calculate the target return on sales
compare the target return on sales
interpret the target return on sales

words.enDefinition: items related to subcontract

examples.en: Welding and painting are subcontract items on this bridge project.
examples.zh: 焊接和喷涂是这座桥梁工程的「转包合同项目」。

examples.en: Any change to subcontract items needs the main contractor's written consent.
examples.zh: 「转包合同项目」如有变动，必须取得总承包商的书面同意。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning straight cost plus

examples.en: Under a straight cost plus contract, the builder's fee never varies.
examples.zh: 在「成本加成合同」下，承建商的酬金固定不变。

examples.en: Auditors questioned hours billed under the straight cost plus contract.
examples.zh: 审计人员对「成本加成合同」下申报的工时提出质疑。

collocations: draft the straight cost plus contract
sign the straight cost plus contract
enforce the straight cost plus contract

words.enDefinition: the cost of financial

examples.en: Higher borrowing rates pushed our financial cost past three million this year.
examples.zh: 借款利率上升使我们的「财务成本」今年突破了三百万元。

examples.en: Leasing the fleet instead of buying cut the group's financial cost noticeably.
examples.zh: 改租车队而非购车，明显降低了集团的「财务成本」。

words.enDefinition: a cost incurred for financial management

examples.en: Bank charges and factoring fees sit in financial management expense.
examples.zh: 银行手续费和保理费都记在「财务管理费用」里。

examples.en: The CFO asked why financial management expense doubled after the acquisition.
examples.zh: 首席财务官追问为何并购之后「财务管理费用」翻倍。

words.enDefinition: management of store

examples.en: Good store management keeps our spare parts findable within a minute.
examples.zh: 良好的「仓库管理」让我们在一分钟内就能找到所需配件。

examples.en: She moved from store management to procurement after the reorganisation.
examples.zh: 重组之后，她从「仓库管理」岗位转到了采购部。

words.enDefinition: a market for strong

examples.en: Dealers describe copper as a strong market heading into the build season.
examples.zh: 交易商认为进入施工旺季后，铜市是「坚挺的市场」。

examples.en: Even in a strong market, we hedge half of every purchase.
examples.zh: 即使面对「坚挺的市场价格」，我们也对每笔采购做一半对冲。

words.enDefinition: a stockholder with a large or controlling holding

examples.en: A strong stockholder blocked the merger before it reached the board.
examples.zh: 一位「大股东」在议案提交董事会前就否决了这次合并。

examples.en: The strong stockholder demanded quarterly briefings on every plant expansion decision.
examples.zh: 这位「实力雄厚的大股东」要求每季度汇报工厂扩建进展。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for finance

examples.en: Late customer payments inflated finance costs beyond the budget line.
examples.zh: 客户回款拖延使「理财成本」超出了预算科目。

examples.en: We trimmed finance costs by renegotiating the overdraft facility with our bank.
examples.zh: 通过重新谈判透支额度，我们压缩了「理财成本」。

words.enDefinition: quality measures for superfine

examples.en: Only superfine quality wool earns the Milan mill's top price.
examples.zh: 只有「特级质量」的羊毛才能卖到米兰纺织厂的最高价。

examples.en: Customers pay extra for superfine quality in our silk bedding range.
examples.zh: 在我们的真丝床品系列中，顾客愿意为「特级质量」多付钱。

words.enDefinition: receipts from fee commission

examples.en: Fee commission receipts from insurance referrals doubled this quarter across all branches.
examples.zh: 本季度保险转介带来的「佣金收入」翻了一番。

examples.en: The branch reports fee commission receipts separately from interest income.
examples.zh: 该分行把「佣金收入」与利息收入分开列报。

words.enDefinition: an approximate estimate of a cost when an exact figure is not yet available

examples.en: The tenderer's approximation of the cost came in under the engineer's estimate.
examples.zh: 投标方的「估算书」低于工程师的估价。

examples.en: Readers should treat the figure as a rough approximation of the cost only.
examples.zh: 读者只能把这个数字当作对成本的粗略「估算」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of approximate

examples.en: Give me an approximate cost today; the exact quote can follow tomorrow.
examples.zh: 今天先给我一个「估算成本」，精确报价明天再补。

examples.en: The approximate cost of rewiring the workshop is around forty thousand.
examples.zh: 车间重新布线的「估算成本」约为四万元。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for approved

examples.en: Nothing gets ordered unless it sits inside the approved budget.
examples.zh: 只要不在「核定预算」之内，任何采购都无法下单。

examples.en: The ministry released the approved budget for the rural clinics in May.
examples.zh: 卫生部于五月拨付了乡村诊所的「核定预算」。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in supply transactions

examples.en: Our supply price holds for sixty days, then freight adjustments apply.
examples.zh: 我们的「供应价格」有效期为六十天，之后按运费调整。

examples.en: The retailer bargained hard over the supply price for winter jackets.
examples.zh: 零售商就冬季夹克的「供应价格」进行了艰苦的讨价还价。

words.enDefinition: schedules listing supply prices

examples.en: Purchasing keeps the supplier's supply price schedules pinned to the wall.
examples.zh: 采购部把供应商的「供应价格表」钉在墙上备查。

examples.en: Outdated supply price schedules caused a string of invoice disputes.
examples.zh: 「供应价格表」过期未更新，引发了一连串发票纠纷。

words.enDefinition: a fee or commission paid in respect of surety

examples.en: The bank charges a surety commission of one percent on the bond.
examples.zh: 银行就保函收取百分之一的「保证手续费」。

examples.en: Renewing the tender surety commission arrangement saved us several hundred dollars.
examples.zh: 续签「保证手续费」协议为我们省下了几百元。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for appropriation

examples.en: Council debates the appropriation budget line for flood defences tonight.
examples.zh: 议会今晚审议防洪工程的「支出(拨款)预算」科目。

examples.en: Money moved into the appropriation budget after the storm damage survey.
examples.zh: 风暴损失勘察之后，资金被划入「拨款预算」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of supplement

examples.en: Rush handling adds a supplement cost of eight percent to the freight bill.
examples.zh: 加急处理会在运费单上增加百分之八的「追加成本」。

examples.en: The supplement cost for weekend delivery nearly wiped out our margin.
examples.zh: 周末送货的「追加成本」几乎吃掉了我们的毛利。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning supplemental

examples.en: Both sides signed a supplemental contract covering the extra workshops.
examples.zh: 双方签订了涵盖额外车间的「增补合同」。

examples.en: Payment terms in the supplemental contract override the original schedule.
examples.zh: 「增补合同」中的付款条款优先于原合同的时间表。

words.enDefinition: the cost of supplementary

examples.en: Training new inspectors is a supplementary cost of the quality drive.
examples.zh: 培训新质检员是质量运动带来的「补充成本」。

examples.en: Include the supplementary cost of packaging in your retail price.
examples.zh: 定价时要把包装的「补充成本」算进零售价。

words.enDefinition: secondary or supporting production alongside a main product

examples.en: Cheese making is a small subsidiary production line on their dairy farm.
examples.zh: 奶酪制作是他们奶牛场的「副业生产」。

examples.en: Subsidiary production of honey covers the farm's fuel bills each winter.
examples.zh: 蜂蜜「副业生产」的收入每年冬天都够支付农场的燃油费。

words.enDefinition: a transaction involving subsidiary commercial

examples.en: Renting the canteen out is a subsidiary commercial transaction for the plant.
examples.zh: 出租食堂对这家工厂来说只是一项「次要的商业交易」。

examples.en: The audit note flags every subsidiary commercial transaction below ten thousand.
examples.zh: 审计底稿对一万元以下的「次要商业交易」逐一作了标注。

words.enDefinition: financing a company largely with debt so that equity holders earn a higher return

examples.en: Trading on equity lifts shareholder returns when borrowing costs stay low.
examples.zh: 在借款成本低廉时，「举债经营」能提高股东回报。

examples.en: The CFO warned that trading on equity cuts both ways in a downturn.
examples.zh: 首席财务官警告说，经济下行时「举债经营」是把双刃剑。

words.enDefinition: a restriction on trade flows or commercial activity

examples.en: A new trade restriction on rare earths rattled every electronics buyer.
examples.zh: 稀土「贸易限制」的新规让所有电子采购商都紧张起来。

examples.en: The chamber lobbied against the trade restriction on second-hand machinery.
examples.zh: 商会游说反对针对二手机械的「贸易限制」。

words.enDefinition: a reference about a firm’s trade creditworthiness

examples.en: Our bank asked for two trade references before granting the credit line.
examples.zh: 银行在授信前要求我们提供两家客户的「商业信誉参考」。

examples.en: The supplier's trade reference mentioned one late payment in five years.
examples.zh: 供应商的「商业信誉证明」显示五年内仅有过一次迟付。

words.enDefinition: a division responsible for trade promotion

examples.en: The trade promotion division funds our booth at the Frankfurt fair.
examples.zh: 「贸易推广部门」为我们的法兰克福展位提供资助。

examples.en: She heads the trade promotion division that vets export grants.
examples.zh: 她主管负责出口补贴审核的「贸易推广部门」。

words.enDefinition: a public commission that regulates or investigates trade and commercial practices (historical/region-specific name)

examples.en: The trade practices commission opened a file on the petrol retailers' pact.
examples.zh: 「贸易惯例委员会」就加油站之间的协议立案调查。

examples.en: Filing with the trade practices commission costs nothing and takes minutes online.
examples.zh: 向「贸易惯例委员会」举报不花一分钱，网上几分钟就能完成。

words.enDefinition: an established commercial practice

examples.en: Cash on delivery remains a common trade practice in the wholesale market.
examples.zh: 货到付款仍是批发市场常见的「商业惯例」。

examples.en: The new trade practice of thirty-day terms upset old suppliers.
examples.zh: 三十天账期这一新「贸易惯例」让老供应商很不适应。

words.enDefinition: a distributor of exclusive

examples.en: She is our exclusive distributor for the whole Baltic region.
examples.zh: 她是我们在整个波罗的海地区的「总经销」。

examples.en: Losing the exclusive distributor forced us to rebuild retail contacts from zero.
examples.zh: 失去「总经销商」后，我们不得不从零重建零售渠道。

words.enDefinition: conditions that govern trade

examples.en: CIF is the trade terms our Middle East clients prefer.
examples.zh: CIF（到岸价）是中东客户偏好的「贸易条件」。

examples.en: We renegotiated the trade terms from FOB to DDP last spring.
examples.zh: 去年春天，我们把「贸易条件」从FOB重新谈成了DDP。

words.enDefinition: a fee or commission paid in respect of transfer

examples.en: The bank levies a transfer commission on every cross-border payment.
examples.zh: 银行对每笔跨境付款都要收取「过户手续费」。

examples.en: Ask the broker whether the transfer commission is negotiable on large lots.
examples.zh: 问一下经纪人，大额交易的「过户手续费」是否可以商量。

words.enDefinition: a transfer of money made for transfer

examples.en: The subsidy reaches farmers as a transfer payment, not a loan.
examples.zh: 补贴以「转移支付」而非贷款的形式发到农户手中。

examples.en: Economists track how each transfer payment changes rural consumption patterns over time.
examples.zh: 经济学家追踪每一笔「转移支付」对农村消费的影响。

words.enDefinition: a transfer of amounts between budget items

examples.en: Moving travel funds into training needs a formal transfer of budget items.
examples.zh: 把差旅经费挪作培训费，需要正式办理「预算项目流用」。

examples.en: The controller approved the transfer of budget items between Q3 and Q4.
examples.zh: 财务控制人批准了第三、四季度之间的「预算项目流用」。

collocations: prioritise the transfer of budget items
standardise the transfer of budget items
monitor the transfer of budget items

words.enDefinition: the total cost incurred in producing goods

examples.en: Energy now makes up a third of our total cost of production.
examples.zh: 能源如今占我们「生产总成本」的三分之一。

examples.en: The total cost of production fell after the second furnace opened.
examples.zh: 第二座熔炉投产后，「生产总成本」有所下降。

words.enDefinition: trade activity concerning total

examples.en: The port's total trade grew steadily despite months of shipping disruptions.
examples.zh: 尽管航运受阻，该港口的「贸易总额」仍在增长。

examples.en: Ministers set a goal of doubling total trade within a decade.
examples.zh: 部长们定下了十年内「贸易总额」翻番的目标。

words.enDefinition: selling activity or proceeds related to total

examples.en: Total sales crossed fifty million for the first time last year.
examples.zh: 去年「销售总额」首次突破五千万元。

examples.en: Bonuses this year depend on total sales, not just individual targets.
examples.zh: 奖金取决于「销售总额」，而不只是个人指标。

words.enDefinition: financial gain arising from total

examples.en: Rising input costs squeezed total profit even as revenue grew.
examples.zh: 尽管收入增长，投入成本上升仍挤压了「总利润」。

examples.en: The group's total profit for the year rests on the holiday season.
examples.zh: 集团全年的「总利润」系于年末的节日销售季。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for total manufacturing

examples.en: Total manufacturing costs include direct labour, materials, and the factory overhead.
examples.zh: 「制造总成本」包括直接人工、材料和间接费用。

examples.en: Every engineer must review total manufacturing costs before the design freeze.
examples.zh: 设计定版之前，每位工程师都要复核「制造总成本」。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for executory

examples.en: Executory costs like maintenance fall on the lessee under this lease.
examples.zh: 按照这份租约，维修等「执行成本」由承租人承担。

examples.en: We separated executory costs from the lease liability schedule for clarity.
examples.zh: 我们把「执行成本」从租赁负债表中单独列了出来。

words.enDefinition: trade classified or conducted by commodity

examples.en: The yearbook reports trade by commodities, from zinc to sesame.
examples.zh: 这本年鉴按「商品贸易」分类统计，从锌到芝麻应有尽有。

examples.en: Trade by commodities statistics hide the booming services flows underneath them.
examples.zh: 单看「商品贸易」会漏掉其下蓬勃的服务贸易流。

words.enDefinition: the net amount remaining for trade

examples.en: A wider trade balance surplus strengthened the currency this spring.
examples.zh: 今年春天，「贸易差额」盈余扩大推高了本币汇率。

examples.en: Energy imports flipped the country's trade balance into a deep deficit.
examples.zh: 能源进口使该国「贸易差额」转为逆差。

words.enDefinition: a mutual arrangement concerning trade and payment

examples.en: The two governments renewed their trade and payment agreement for five years.
examples.zh: 两国政府把「贸易和支付协定」续签了五年。

examples.en: Settlements run through the clearing channel set by the trade and payment agreement.
examples.zh: 结算按照「贸易和支付协定」设立的清算渠道进行。

collocations: negotiate the trade and payment agreement
renew the trade and payment agreement
terminate the trade and payment agreement

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track trade

examples.en: Collections for export orders land in our dedicated trade account daily.
examples.zh: 出口货款都归集到我们专设的「贸易账户」里。

examples.en: The treasurer sweeps the trade account clean every Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 司库每周五下午都会清空「贸易账户」的资金。

words.enDefinition: obligations related to trade

examples.en: Trade liabilities to suppliers rose as buyers slowed their payments.
examples.zh: 由于下游回款放缓，对供应商的「营业负债」不断攀升。

examples.en: Stretching trade liabilities is a common way startups finance inventory.
examples.zh: 拉长「营业负债」账期是初创公司为存货融资的常用手段。

words.enDefinition: an amount deducted or set aside for trade in

examples.en: The dealer offered a generous trade in allowance on our old van.
examples.zh: 车行对我们那辆旧货车给出了丰厚的「抵换折扣」。

examples.en: Accounting treats the trade in allowance as part proceeds of disposal.
examples.zh: 会计上把「抵换折让」视作处置旧资产的部分对价。

words.enDefinition: a firm dealing in trade

examples.en: An old Osaka trade house introduced our ceramics to European buyers.
examples.zh: 大阪一家老牌「贸易行」把我们的陶瓷介绍给了欧洲买主。

examples.en: The trade house takes a slice of every shipment it handles.
examples.zh: 这家「贸易行」从经手的每批货物中抽取佣金。

words.enDefinition: an exhibition where firms display and promote goods

examples.en: We booked a corner stand at the Canton trade fair.
examples.zh: 我们在广交会这个「商业展览会」订了一个角落展位。

examples.en: The trade fair in Hanover yielded forty qualified leads for sales.
examples.zh: 汉诺威的「商展」为我们带来了四十个合格线索。

words.enDefinition: estate related to trade

examples.en: The council opened a trade estate for light industry near the ring road.
examples.zh: 议会在环城路附近开辟了一个轻工业「商业用地」园区。

examples.en: Rents on the trade estate undercut every private warehouse nearby.
examples.zh: 这片「商业用地」的租金比附近所有私营仓库都便宜。

words.enDefinition: a system for trade cost

examples.en: Their trade cost system tracks every charge from quay to customer.
examples.zh: 他们的「商业成本制度」追踪从码头到客户的每一项费用。

examples.en: Auditors approved the trade cost system after minor documentation fixes.
examples.zh: 在补齐少量单据之后，审计人员认可了这套「商业成本制度」。

words.enDefinition: an excess of imports over exports

examples.en: The trade deficit widened as gadget imports hit record levels.
examples.zh: 小家电进口创新高，「贸易赤字」进一步扩大。

examples.en: Exporters promise the trade deficit will narrow once the harvest ships.
examples.zh: 出口商承诺，待收成装运后「贸易逆差」将会收窄。

words.enDefinition: the cost of direct expenses

examples.en: Travel for commissioning crews is a direct expenses cost of the project.
examples.zh: 调试小组的差旅属于该项目的「直接费用成本」。

examples.en: We invoice the client for direct expenses cost at documented rates.
examples.zh: 我们按有凭证的费率向客户收取「直接费用成本」。

words.enDefinition: a formal presentation of information about direct costing income

examples.en: Management studies a direct costing income statement beside the statutory one.
examples.zh: 管理层在法定报表之外还研读「直接成本计算收益表」。

examples.en: The direct costing income statement separates fixed costs from contribution margin.
examples.zh: 「直接成本计算收益表」把固定成本与贡献毛益分开列示。

collocations: sign the direct costing income statement
attach the direct costing income statement
archive the direct costing income statement

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for direct labour cost

examples.en: Overtime approvals must cite the direct labour cost budget first.
examples.zh: 批准加班前必须先核对「直接人工成本预算」。

examples.en: The direct labour cost budget assumed one hundred and ten assemblers.
examples.zh: 「直接人工成本预算」按一百一十名装配工编制。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for direct material cost

examples.en: Copper prices wrecked our direct material cost budget within a quarter.
examples.zh: 铜价在一个季度内就击穿了我们的「直接材料成本预算」。

examples.en: Purchasing reports variances against the direct material cost budget weekly.
examples.zh: 采购部每周汇报与「直接材料成本预算」的差异。

words.enDefinition: a warehouse for ex

examples.en: We sell the flour ex warehouse, so collection and haulage are yours.
examples.zh: 我们按「仓库交货」价出售面粉，提货和运输由贵方自理。

examples.en: Buyers compare the ex warehouse quote with delivered options before deciding.
examples.zh: 买方会先把「仓库交货」报价与送货到门的方案做比较再决定。

collocations: clear goods through the ex warehouse

words.enDefinition: conditions that govern ex warehouse

examples.en: Ex warehouse terms suit buyers who already run their own trucks.
examples.zh: 「仓库交货条件」适合已有自有车队的买方。

examples.en: Under ex warehouse terms, insurance risk passes at the shed door.
examples.zh: 按「仓库交货条件」，风险在库房门口即转移给买方。

words.enDefinition: the cost of ex works

examples.en: Our ex works cost covers crating but excludes inland freight.
examples.zh: 我们的「工厂交货成本」包含木箱包装，但不含内陆运费。

examples.en: Distributors complain the ex works cost leaves them exposed to fuel spikes.
examples.zh: 经销商抱怨「工厂交货成本」让他们独自承受油价波动。

words.enDefinition: a warehouse for ex buyer's bonded

examples.en: We quote ex buyer's bonded warehouse, so duty falls on your account.
examples.zh: 我们按「买方关栈交货价格」报价，关税由贵方承担。

examples.en: Deliveries ex buyer's bonded warehouse begin once the licence clears.
examples.zh: 许可证办妥后，即按「买方关栈交货」开始交付。

collocations: inspect the ex buyer's bonded warehouse
clear goods through the ex buyer's bonded warehouse
stock the ex buyer's bonded warehouse

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with allied export selling

examples.en: Four knitwear mills formed an allied export selling company together.
examples.zh: 四家针织厂共同组建了一家「联营出口公司」。

examples.en: The allied export selling company negotiates freight rates for all members.
examples.zh: 这家「联营出口公司」为所有成员统一谈判运价。

collocations: scope the allied export selling company
own the allied export selling company
handover the allied export selling company

words.enDefinition: profit oil that can be allocated among parties

examples.en: Cost recovery comes first, then allocable profit oil splits by the PSA formula.
examples.zh: 先回收成本，再按产品分成合同公式分配「利润分成油」。

examples.en: Falling prices shrank the allocable profit oil for both consortium partners.
examples.zh: 油价下跌使财团双方可分的「利润分成油」都缩水了。

words.enDefinition: the cost of transferred-in

examples.en: Transferred-in cost from the smelting stage follows every ingot to rolling.
examples.zh: 每块铸锭都带着上一熔炼工序转入的「前部成本」。

examples.en: Managers questioned why transferred-in cost doubled at the plating line.
examples.zh: 管理层质疑为何电镀线的「前部成本」翻倍了。

words.zhGloss: 包括一切费用在内的价格
words.enDefinition: prices charged in all transactions
acceptedZhAnswers: 包括一切费用在内的价格

examples.en: Our tender states all prices include packing, insurance, and duties.
examples.zh: 我们的标书注明「所有价格」均含包装、保险和关税。

examples.en: Compare all prices on the sheet carefully before shortlisting any suppliers.
examples.zh: 筛选供应商之前，先比较表上的「全部价格」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for all round

examples.en: The wholesaler quoted an all round price covering delivery and fitting.
examples.zh: 批发商报出了一个含送货和安装的「全包价格」。

examples.en: An all round price avoids disputes over every little surcharge.
examples.zh: 「全包价格」可以避免在各项小附加费上扯皮。

words.enDefinition: management of transportation

examples.en: Good transportation management cut empty return runs almost in half.
examples.zh: 出色的「运输管理」使空驶回程几乎减少了一半。

examples.en: She studied transportation management at college before joining the logistics startup.
examples.zh: 加入这家物流初创公司之前，她学的是「运输管理」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of transportation

examples.en: Rail freight keeps our transportation cost steady even when diesel spikes.
examples.zh: 即使柴油价格飙升，铁路货运也让我们的「运输成本」保持稳定。

examples.en: Consolidating our weekly shipments lowered transportation cost by eleven percent overall.
examples.zh: 合并每周发运批次使「运输成本」下降了百分之十一。

words.enDefinition: a bill of exchange arising from an export trade transaction

examples.en: The negotiating bank discounted the export trade bill on sight.
examples.zh: 议付行见票即贴现了这张「出口贸易单据」。

examples.en: Each export trade bill must reference the underlying sales contract.
examples.zh: 每张「出口贸易汇票」都必须注明对应的销售合同。

words.enDefinition: trade activity concerning export

examples.en: The harbour town lives almost entirely on export trade with Europe.
examples.zh: 这座港口小城几乎完全依靠「外销」生意。

examples.en: Export trade in machinery overtook textiles for the first time.
examples.zh: 机械的「出口贸易」首次超过了纺织品。

words.enDefinition: payment received in advance for export goods

examples.en: The buyer wired an export prepayment of thirty percent against the proforma.
examples.zh: 买方按形式发票电汇了百分之三十的「出口预付款」。

examples.en: Export prepayment lets the workshop buy leather before the season starts.
examples.zh: 「出口预付款」让作坊能在旺季前买好皮革。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in export transactions

examples.en: Currency swings squeezed the export price below the domestic level.
examples.zh: 汇率波动使「出口价格」被压到国内价格之下。

examples.en: We lift the export price slightly when order volumes are small.
examples.zh: 订单量小的时候，我们会把「出口价格」略微上调。

words.enDefinition: a tender for export

examples.en: The power authority floated an export tender for transformer units.
examples.zh: 电力部门为变压器设备发布了「出口招标」。

examples.en: Winning the export tender took three rounds of technical clarifications.
examples.zh: 赢得这宗「出口招标」经过了三轮技术澄清。

words.enDefinition: a board that oversees export-import

examples.en: Licensing applications now run through the export-import board's online portal.
examples.zh: 许可证办理如今要走「进出口管理委员会」的线上门户。

examples.en: The export-import board relaxed its rules for small consignments last month.
examples.zh: 「进出口管理委员会」放宽了对小额货载的规定。

words.enDefinition: an industry organised mainly for export markets

examples.en: Electronics remains the region's leading export-oriented industry by a wide margin.
examples.zh: 电子业仍是该地区最主要的「面向出口的工业」。

examples.en: An export-oriented industry struggles whenever the home currency strengthens too quickly.
examples.zh: 本币走强时，「出口导向型产业」的日子会很不好过。

words.enDefinition: a letter of credit available to an exporter under an export sale

examples.en: Check the export letter of credit clauses before booking the vessel.
examples.zh: 订舱之前，先核对「出口信用证」的条款。

examples.en: A discrepant export letter of credit delayed payment by three weeks.
examples.zh: 「出口信用证」因单证不符，导致收款推迟了三周。

collocations: arrange the export letter of credit
monitor the export letter of credit
repay the export letter of credit

words.enDefinition: payments for temporary

examples.en: Book the advance as temporary payments until the invoice is issued.
examples.zh: 开票之前，先把这笔预付款记作「暂付款项」。

examples.en: Auditors traced every temporary payments balance to its closing document.
examples.zh: 审计人员把每笔「暂付款项」余额都追到了结清凭证。

words.enDefinition: a costing method that accumulates costs for a specific contract or job through to completion

examples.en: Terminal costing accumulates every expense until the vessel is handed over.
examples.zh: 「定期成本计算」把造船的全部费用归集到交付为止。

examples.en: The yard switched to terminal costing for its long refit contracts.
examples.zh: 船厂对长期改装合同改用了「完工成本计算」。

words.enDefinition: a group that colludes on tenders

examples.en: Investigators exposed a tendering ring fixing bids for the bridge job.
examples.zh: 调查人员揭露了操纵大桥工程投标的「围标集团」。

examples.en: Any tendering ring discovered on this project ends the contract immediately.
examples.zh: 一经发现「围标」行为，合同立即终止。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in tender transactions

examples.en: Our tender price covers the cables but not the towers.
examples.zh: 我们的「投标价格」包含电缆，但不含塔架。

examples.en: The winning tender price surprised everyone by landing eight percent low.
examples.zh: 中标「投标价」比预期低了百分之八，令所有人意外。

words.enDefinition: an invitation to tender

examples.en: The city's tender invitation closes on the last Friday of March.
examples.zh: 市政府的「招标」将于三月的最后一个星期五截止。

examples.en: Read every annex carefully before answering the tender invitation in writing.
examples.zh: 答复「招标邀请」前，务必读完每一份附件。

words.enDefinition: a surety bond supporting a bidder’s obligation under a tender (also called a bid bond)

examples.en: Bid without a tender bond and the committee returns your documents.
examples.zh: 没有「投标保证金」，委员会会直接退回你的标书。

examples.en: The tender bond stays valid until the contract is awarded.
examples.zh: 「投标保证金」的有效期持续到合同授标为止。

words.enDefinition: the agreed terms on which payment or delivery is settled

examples.en: Buyers accepted a term of settlement of sixty days after invoice.
examples.zh: 买方接受了发票后六十天的「付款条件」。

examples.en: Each term of settlement is printed at the foot of the order form.
examples.zh: 每张订单下方都印着「结算条款」。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for expense

examples.en: The regional office blew its expense budget on a client conference.
examples.zh: 区域办公室为一场客户会议花光了「费用预算」。

examples.en: Each quarter we rebalance the expense budget across the four teams.
examples.zh: 每季度我们都会在四个团队之间重新平衡「费用预算」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of expense

examples.en: Separate the expense cost of running the showroom from stock purchases.
examples.zh: 把展厅运营的「费用成本」与进货支出分开核算。

examples.en: The expense cost of the pilot reached twice the original estimate.
examples.zh: 试点的「费用成本」达到了最初估计的两倍。

words.enDefinition: a purchase of time

examples.en: Farmers make a time purchase of fertiliser ahead of each planting season.
examples.zh: 农户在每个播种季前都会「分期付款采购」化肥。

examples.en: A time purchase on the delivery vans eased pressure on cash.
examples.zh: 对送货货车采用「分期付款采购」缓解了现金压力。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in exhaust transactions

examples.en: Positions are force-closed by the exchange once the exhaust price is reached.
examples.zh: 一旦触及「交易所押金不足时的价格」，持仓就会被强制平仓。

examples.en: The pit clerk posted the exhaust price before the opening bell.
examples.zh: 开盘铃响之前，场内职员贴出了「押金不足价格」。

words.enDefinition: prices charged in exorbitant transactions

examples.en: Vendors charged exorbitant prices for bottled water after the outage.
examples.zh: 停水期间，小贩对瓶装水开出了「过高价格」。

examples.en: Regulators fined the hotel for exorbitant prices during the festival.
examples.zh: 节庆期间「价格过高」，该酒店被监管机构罚款。

words.enDefinition: an agent acting for export

examples.en: An experienced export agent in Rotterdam handles all our shipping documentation.
examples.zh: 鹿特丹一位经验丰富的「出口代理商」负责处理我们的单证。

examples.en: The export agent takes four percent but opens doors we never could.
examples.zh: 这位「出口代理商」抽四个点，却能打开我们打不开的门路。

words.enDefinition: an entry for export

examples.en: Customs rejected the export entry because the tariff code was wrong.
examples.zh: 海关因税则号填错而退回了「出口报单」。

examples.en: The broker files each export entry within twenty-four hours of loading.
examples.zh: 报关行在装货后二十四小时内提交每份「出口报单」。

words.enDefinition: earnings from export

examples.en: Tea remains the island's single largest source of export earnings today.
examples.zh: 茶叶仍是这座岛屿「出口收益」的最大来源。

examples.en: Falling export earnings forced the mill to delay its upgrade.
examples.zh: 「出口收益」下滑，迫使工厂推迟了设备升级。

words.enDefinition: a bill of exchange used in an export transaction

examples.en: The bank negotiated the export bill against the shipping documents.
examples.zh: 银行凭货运单据议付了这张「出口汇票」。

examples.en: Discounting the export bill freed cash for the next purchase.
examples.zh: 贴现「出口汇票」为下一轮采购腾出了现金。

words.enDefinition: a subsidy or bounty paid on exports

examples.en: Shipbuilders once depended on an export bounty to stay competitive.
examples.zh: 造船商曾依靠「出口补助金」来保持竞争力。

examples.en: The export bounty on refined sugar ends next March, exporters say.
examples.zh: 精糖的「出口补助金」将于明年三月取消。

words.enDefinition: an analysis of profits earned by a business

examples.en: The bank's loan officer asked for an analysis of business profits by segment.
examples.zh: 银行信贷员要求提供分业务的「企业利润分析」。

examples.en: Their analysis of business profits blamed currency swings for the slide.
examples.zh: 他们的「企业利润分析」把利润下滑归因于汇率波动。

words.enDefinition: an order related to expenses standing

examples.en: Rent leaves the club's account through an expenses standing order each month.
examples.zh: 房租通过每月的「费用自动转账指令」从俱乐部账户扣走。

examples.en: She set up an expenses standing order for the insurance premium.
examples.zh: 她为保险费设置了一笔「费用自动转账指令」。

words.enDefinition: the expense incurred in producing goods

examples.en: Electricity is the largest expense of production at the smelter.
examples.zh: 电力是冶炼厂最大的「生产费用」。

examples.en: Lowering the expense of production starts with waste heat recovery.
examples.zh: 降低「生产费用」要从废热回收做起。

words.enDefinition: a commission or public body concerned with mixed

examples.en: A mixed commission of officials and traders oversees the border market.
examples.zh: 由官员和商人组成的「混合委员会」负责监管边境市场。

examples.en: The mixed commission meets twice a year to settle shipping disputes.
examples.zh: 「混合委员会」每年开会两次，解决航运纠纷。

words.enDefinition: the cost of intangible drilling

examples.en: Most exploration spending counts as intangible drilling cost for tax purposes.
examples.zh: 在税务上，大部分勘探支出都属于「无形钻探费用」。

examples.en: Intangible drilling cost deductions eased the wildcatter's tax bill considerably.
examples.zh: 「无形钻探成本」扣除减轻了这家勘探公司的税负。

words.enDefinition: ownership interest related to minority

examples.en: The parent consolidates the subsidiary but reports minority equity separately.
examples.zh: 母公司合并子公司报表，但单独列示「少数股东权益」。

examples.en: Minority equity in the toll-road venture grew with every new interchange.
examples.zh: 随着每个新互通立交建成，收费路项目中的「少数股东权益」不断增长。

words.enDefinition: transfer of amounts between budget items

examples.en: An inter-transfer of budget items shifted funds from events to security.
examples.zh: 一笔「预算项目流用」把经费从活动转到了安保。

examples.en: Finance tightened rules on inter-transfer of budget items after the audit.
examples.zh: 审计之后，财务部门收紧了「预算项目流用」的规定。

words.enDefinition: a charge or stake related to minority

examples.en: Minority interest in the overseas venture shrank after the buyback.
examples.zh: 回购之后，海外合营项目中的「少数股东权益」有所缩减。

examples.en: Calculate minority interest very carefully before consolidating the group accounts.
examples.zh: 合并集团报表之前，先计算「少数(股东)权益」。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage minimum stock

examples.en: Minimum stock control keeps one week of spares on the shelf.
examples.zh: 「最低库存量管理」保证货架上始终备有一周的配件。

examples.en: The hospital credits minimum stock control for zero drug-outs last winter.
examples.zh: 去年冬天药品零断供，院方归功于「最低库存量控制」。

words.enDefinition: a market for cooperative wholesale

examples.en: Growers truck their melons to the cooperative wholesale market before dawn.
examples.zh: 瓜农天不亮就把瓜运往「合作批发市场」。

examples.en: Prices at the cooperative wholesale market set the tone for retail that day.
examples.zh: 「合作批发市场」的价格往往决定了当天零售行情的基调。

words.enDefinition: financial gain arising from inter-company

examples.en: Consolidation removes any inter-company profit still sitting in closing inventory.
examples.zh: 合并报表时会剔除存货中尚存的「公司间内部利润」。

examples.en: The auditor traced inter-company profit elimination across all three entities.
examples.zh: 审计师逐一核查了三家实体间「公司间利润」的抵销。

words.enDefinition: prices charged in inter-company transactions

examples.en: Tax authorities scrutinise inter-company prices on every single component transfer.
examples.zh: 税务机关对每次零部件调拨的「公司内部价格」都要审查。

examples.en: We benchmark our inter-company prices against market quotes each year.
examples.zh: 我们每年都把「公司内部价格」与市场报价作基准比较。

words.enDefinition: a market for inter-company loan

examples.en: Treasury centres borrow in the inter-company loan market before touching banks.
examples.zh: 资金中心在动用银行之前会先到「公司间借贷市场」融资。

examples.en: Rates in the inter-company loan market track our internal reference curve.
examples.zh: 「公司间借贷市场」的利率跟随我们的内部基准曲线。

words.enDefinition: selling activity or proceeds related to inter company

examples.en: Inter company sales between the plants must cancel out in consolidation.
examples.zh: 工厂之间的「公司间销售」在合并时必须相互抵销。

examples.en: The pricing team reviews inter company sales margins every quarter.
examples.zh: 定价团队每季度审查「公司间销售」的毛利水平。

words.enDefinition: a market for inter-company deposit

examples.en: Surplus cash parks overnight in the inter-company deposit market at mid-rates.
examples.zh: 闲置资金隔夜存放在「公司间存款市场」。

examples.en: The group's inter-company deposit market charges a mid-rate plus five points.
examples.zh: 集团「公司间存款市场」按中间价加五个基点计息。

collocations: clear goods through the inter-company deposit market

words.enDefinition: revenues from miscellaneous

examples.en: Scrap sales flow into miscellaneous revenues rather than turnover lines.
examples.zh: 废料销售收入计入「杂项收入」，而非主营业务收入。

examples.en: Miscellaneous revenues from subletting the annex covered the rent shortfall.
examples.zh: 转租产生的「杂项收入」弥补了租金缺口。

words.enDefinition: financial gain arising from corporate

examples.en: Corporate profit fell last year even though factory output held steady.
examples.zh: 尽管工厂产量保持稳定，「公司利润」仍出现了下滑。

examples.en: The tax debate treats corporate profit as the fairest base.
examples.zh: 这场税收辩论把「公司利润」视为最公平的税基。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for corporate and administrative

examples.en: Corporate and administrative costs rose faster than revenue last year.
examples.zh: 去年「公司及行政成本」的增速超过了收入增速。

examples.en: Outsourcing payroll trimmed corporate and administrative costs by a tenth.
examples.zh: 把薪酬核算外包后，「公司及行政成本」削减了一成。

words.enDefinition: funding for corporate asset

examples.en: Corporate asset funding through sale-leaseback freed cash for urgent R&D.
examples.zh: 通过售后回租进行「公司资产筹资」，为研发腾出了现金。

examples.en: Banks offer corporate asset funding secured against receivables and equipment.
examples.zh: 银行以应收账款和设备为担保提供「公司资产筹资」。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning installment

examples.en: Buyers signed an installment contract for the greenhouse equipment last week.
examples.zh: 买方为温室设备签订了一份「分期付款合同」。

examples.en: Under the installment contract, title passes with the final payment.
examples.zh: 按照「分期付款合同」，所有权随最后一期付款而转移。

words.enDefinition: revenue arising from installment

examples.en: Installment revenue is recognised gradually as each payment is collected.
examples.zh: 「分期付款销货收入」按每期收款确认。

examples.en: The furniture store books installment revenue across twenty-four monthly periods.
examples.zh: 这家家具店把「分期付款销货收入」在二十四个月内分期入账。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning installment sales

examples.en: The tractor deal closed under a standard installment sales contract.
examples.zh: 这笔拖拉机交易按标准「分期付款销售合同」成交。

examples.en: Defaulting on the installment sales contract triggers repossession of the rig.
examples.zh: 拖欠「分期付款销售合同」的款项将导致设备被收回。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage mechanical cost

examples.en: Mechanical cost control on the presses means checking every hour meter.
examples.zh: 对压机的「机械成本管理」意味着每小时都要核对工时表。

examples.en: Maintenance leads own mechanical cost control across the four plants.
examples.zh: 维修主管负责四家工厂的「机械成本管理」。

words.enDefinition: a bill of exchange used to finance commercial trade

examples.en: The importer honoured the commercial bill at ninety days after sight.
examples.zh: 进口商对这张九十天期的「商业汇票」作了承兑。

examples.en: Discounting a commercial bill is cheaper than overdrawing the account.
examples.zh: 贴现「商业汇票」比透支账户更划算。

words.enDefinition: a commercial attaché at an embassy or consulate

examples.en: Our commercial attache arranged introductions to three key ministry buyers.
examples.zh: 我们的「商业参事」安排了与三位部委采购官员的会面。

examples.en: Ask the commercial attache to verify the tender's authenticity first.
examples.zh: 请「商务参赞」核实这次招标的真实性。

words.enDefinition: an act or transaction carried out in the course of commerce

examples.en: Under the commercial code, every commercial act needs proper books and records.
examples.zh: 依照商法典，每项「商事行为」都必须有规范的账簿记录。

examples.en: Whether leasing counts as a commercial act decides which court hears the case.
examples.zh: 租赁是否属于「商事行为」，决定了案件由哪个法院审理。

words.enDefinition: advertising for commercial

examples.en: Commercial advertising on local radio still drives our weekend footfall.
examples.zh: 地方电台的「商业广告」依然能带动我们周末的客流。

examples.en: The law bans commercial advertising aimed at children under twelve.
examples.zh: 法律禁止面向十二岁以下儿童的「商业广告」。

words.enDefinition: an agency dealing with commercial

examples.en: A Lyon commercial agency represents us across the wine trade.
examples.zh: 里昂的一家「商业代理所」代理我们的葡萄酒业务。

examples.en: The commercial agency earns five percent on every signed order.
examples.zh: 这家「商业代理所」按每张签约订单抽取百分之五佣金。

words.enDefinition: an agent acting for commercial

examples.en: Our commercial agent in Cairo knows every customs officer by name.
examples.zh: 我们在开罗的「代理商」认识每一位海关官员。

examples.en: A good commercial agent saves months of cold-calling in a new market.
examples.zh: 一位得力的「商务代理」能省去数月的陌生电访。

words.enDefinition: arbitration of commercial

examples.en: The sales contract routes every dispute to commercial arbitration in Singapore.
examples.zh: 销售合同约定一切争议交由新加坡「商业仲裁」解决。

examples.en: Commercial arbitration settled the freight row within six short weeks.
examples.zh: 「商事仲裁」在六周内了结了这场运费纠纷。

words.enDefinition: the record of a country’s transactions with the rest of the world

examples.en: Oil receipts swung the international balance of payments into surplus.
examples.zh: 石油收入使「国际支付差额」转为顺差。

examples.en: Analysts read the international balance of payments monthly, line by line.
examples.zh: 分析师逐行研读每月的「国际收支差额」。

collocations: prioritise the international balance of payments
standardise the international balance of payments
monitor the international balance of payments

words.enDefinition: a commercial business firm; a shop or trading company

examples.en: Every commercial firm on the street closes for the holiday.
examples.zh: 这条街上每家「商店」都歇业过节。

examples.en: The insurance covers any commercial firm trading from the premises.
examples.zh: 该保险覆盖在此经营的所有「商业公司」。

words.enDefinition: a guild or association of commercial traders

examples.en: The commercial guild sets training standards for the city's goldsmiths.
examples.zh: 「商业协会」为全城金匠制定培训标准。

examples.en: Membership in the commercial guild unlocks the wholesale hall's rates.
examples.zh: 加入「商业公会」才能享受批发大厅的优惠价。

words.enDefinition: a bank’s conditional undertaking to pay a beneficiary when stipulated documents are presented (letter of credit)

examples.en: We opened a commercial letter of credit at sight through our branch.
examples.zh: 我们通过分行开立了一张即期「商业信用状」。

examples.en: The commercial letter of credit named three documents no one could supply.
examples.zh: 这份「商业信用证」要求的三种单据谁都开不出来。

collocations: arrange the commercial letter of credit
monitor the commercial letter of credit
repay the commercial letter of credit

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for materials inventory

examples.en: Purchasing builds the materials inventory budget from the production plan.
examples.zh: 采购部根据生产计划编制「库存材料预算」。

examples.en: The materials inventory budget caps steel on hand at six weeks.
examples.zh: 「库存材料预算」把钢材备货上限设为六周用量。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for materials cost

examples.en: Resin prices blew through the materials cost budget in March.
examples.zh: 三月，树脂价格击穿了「材料成本预算」。

examples.en: Each plant defends its materials cost budget at the quarterly review.
examples.zh: 每家工厂都要在季度评审会上说明「材料成本预算」的执行情况。

words.enDefinition: a correspondence for commercial

examples.en: Old commercial correspondence in the archive traces the firm back to 1911.
examples.zh: 档案里的旧「商业信函」把这家公司的历史追溯到1911年。

examples.en: Her evening course teaches commercial correspondence, from enquiries to complaints.
examples.zh: 她的课程教授「商务信函」写作，从询盘到投诉都有涉及。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage commercial

examples.en: Discount approval sits at the heart of commercial control here.
examples.zh: 折扣审批是这里「商业管控」的核心环节。

examples.en: Weak commercial control let one rep sign off his own rebates.
examples.zh: 「商业管控」松懈，竟让一名销售核准了自己的返利。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning commercial

examples.en: Our lawyer reviews every commercial contract longer than two pages.
examples.zh: 超过两页的「贸易合同」都由律师把关。

examples.en: The commercial contract requires all disputes to be heard locally.
examples.zh: 这份「商业合同」规定纠纷须在本地审理。

words.enDefinition: a business concern in commercial

examples.en: A small commercial concern like ours lives or dies on cash flow.
examples.zh: 像我们这样的小型「商店」，现金流决定生死。

examples.en: The grant is open to any commercial concern under fifty staff.
examples.zh: 员工不足五十人的任何「商业企业」都可申请这笔补助。

words.enDefinition: a partnership for commercial company

examples.en: The two cousins built a commercial company partnership around the import licence.
examples.zh: 堂兄弟俩围绕这张进口许可证组建了「商业合伙公司」。

examples.en: Liability in a commercial company partnership extends to personal assets.
examples.zh: 「商业合伙公司」的责任可以追及个人财产。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with commercial

examples.en: The ferry operator is a commercial company, not a state agency.
examples.zh: 这家轮渡运营方是「贸易公司」，而非政府机构。

examples.en: Every commercial company in the zone pays a flat annual levy.
examples.zh: 区内每家「商业公司」都要缴纳固定年费。

words.enDefinition: a depression for commercial

examples.en: During the commercial depression, three of the five mills went quiet.
examples.zh: 「商业萧条」期间，五家工厂中有三家停了工。

examples.en: Rail freight volumes mirror every commercial depression with a lag.
examples.zh: 铁路货运量滞后地映照出每一轮「商业萧条」。

words.enDefinition: a disappearance for commercial

examples.en: Commercial disappearance of butter slowed as cold stores filled up.
examples.zh: 随着冷库渐满，黄油的「商业销售」速度放缓。

examples.en: The board tracks monthly commercial disappearance of cheese to set support prices.
examples.zh: 委员会按月跟踪奶酪的「商业销售量」，以此制定支持价格。

words.enDefinition: a reduction from the normal amount for commercial

examples.en: Trade buyers take a commercial discount of ten percent off list.
examples.zh: 大宗买主可享受低于牌价百分之十的「商业折扣」。

examples.en: The invoice shows the commercial discount in a separate column.
examples.zh: 发票上把「商业折扣」单独列成一栏。

words.enDefinition: a center for commercial distribution

examples.en: Trucks leave the commercial distribution center at four each morning.
examples.zh: 货车每天清晨四点从「商业销售中心」出发。

examples.en: The new commercial distribution center cut delivery times to two days.
examples.zh: 新建的「商业分销中心」把送货时间缩短到两天。

words.enDefinition: efficiency in commercial operations

examples.en: New route software improved commercial efficiency across the delivery fleet.
examples.zh: 路线软件提升了整个车队的「商业经营效率」。

examples.en: The audit benchmarks commercial efficiency against three rival regional chains.
examples.zh: 审计以三家连锁对手为基准评估「商业经营效率」。

words.enDefinition: the resources and facilities used to produce goods

examples.en: Land, looms, and licences are the means of production here.
examples.zh: 土地、织机和牌照就是这里的「生产手段」。

examples.en: The co-op pooled members' means of production to bid for contracts.
examples.zh: 合作社汇集社员的「生产资料」去竞标工程。

words.enDefinition: an operation involving commercial

examples.en: The wind farm finally began commercial operation in October last year.
examples.zh: 这座风电场于十月投入「商业运营」。

examples.en: Every commercial operation on the estate pays service charges quarterly.
examples.zh: 园区内每个「商业经营」单位都按季度缴纳服务费。

words.enDefinition: a market for commercial paper

examples.en: Tightening credit shut many firms out of the commercial paper market.
examples.zh: 信贷紧缩把许多公司挡在了「商业票据市场」之外。

examples.en: Blue chips roll their short-term needs in the commercial paper market.
examples.zh: 蓝筹公司靠「商业票据市场」滚动满足短期资金需求。

collocations: clear goods through the commercial paper market

words.enDefinition: a firm dealing in commercial paper

examples.en: A commercial paper house placed our short-term notes within a day.
examples.zh: 一家「商业票据公司」在一天内就把我们的短期票据发售完毕。

examples.en: The commercial paper house charges ten basis points for placement.
examples.zh: 这家「票据行」按十个基点收取发售佣金。

words.enDefinition: an order related to international payment

examples.en: Head office issued an international payment order for the royalty.
examples.zh: 总部为这笔特许权使用费签发了「国际付款支付书」。

examples.en: Each international payment order must carry the bank's authentication stamp.
examples.zh: 每份「国际付款支付书」都盖有银行的鉴证章。

words.enDefinition: marketing of international

examples.en: Our international marketing team localises every campaign market by market.
examples.zh: 我们的「国际营销」团队逐个市场对活动做本地化。

examples.en: Good international marketing respects local habits, and not just language.
examples.zh: 成功的「国际市场推销」尊重当地习俗，而不只是翻译语言。

words.enDefinition: wholesalers that supply mills with materials and equipment

examples.en: Mill supply wholesalers keep the region's sawmills running with spare blades.
examples.zh: 「工厂供应批发商」用备用锯片维持着地区锯木厂的运转。

examples.en: Mill supply wholesalers extended sixty-day terms to keep the plant loyal.
examples.zh: 「工厂供应批发商」给了六十天账期，留住了这家工厂。

words.enDefinition: the cost of collection

examples.en: Chasing overdue invoices adds a collection cost nobody budgets for.
examples.zh: 追讨逾期账款会产生没人做预算的「托收成本」。

examples.en: Factoring shifts the collection cost onto the finance house instead.
