examples.zh: 保理业务把「托收成本」转给了保理商。

words.enDefinition: trade activity concerning combination deal

examples.en: The state firm practices combination deal trade, swapping oil for rails.
examples.zh: 这家国企做「进出口结合贸易」，用石油换钢轨。

examples.en: Combination deal trade neatly sidesteps hard-currency shortages during sanctions years.
examples.zh: 在制裁年份，「进出口结合贸易」可以绕开硬通货短缺。

words.enDefinition: quality measures for merchantable

examples.en: The warranty promises goods of merchantable quality or a full refund.
examples.zh: 保修承诺商品达到「可销售的质量」，否则全额退款。

examples.en: Grading stations reject any lot that falls below merchantable quality.
examples.zh: 分级站会拒收任何低于「适销质量」的货批。

words.enDefinition: a market for internal labour

examples.en: Vacancies post inside first; our internal labour market fills most roles.
examples.zh: 空缺先内部公示，我们的「内部劳动力市场」能填补大部分岗位。

examples.en: A closed internal labour market breeds stale thinking on the floor.
examples.zh: 封闭的「内部劳动力市场」容易滋生僵化思维。

words.enDefinition: the cost of merchandise procurement

examples.en: Freight and duties push merchandise procurement cost past the sticker price.
examples.zh: 运费和关税使「商品采购成本」超过了标价。

examples.en: Negotiating CIF terms cut merchandise procurement cost by four points.
examples.zh: 谈成CIF条款后，「商品采购成本」降低了四个百分点。

words.enDefinition: revenue arising from non-operating

examples.en: Renting out our rooftop mast counts as non-operating revenue for tax.
examples.zh: 出租楼顶的铁塔属于「非营业收入」。

examples.en: Non-operating revenue from the car park covered the canteen's losses.
examples.zh: 停车场带来的「非营业收入」填补了食堂的亏损。

words.enDefinition: the cost of non-recurring

examples.en: Factory relocation was a non-recurring cost, unlike the annual audits.
examples.zh: 工厂搬迁属于「临时成本」，不同于每年一度的审计费。

examples.en: Strip out every non-recurring cost before comparing the two bids.
examples.zh: 比较两份标书之前，先剔除所有「非经常性成本」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for non-flexible

examples.en: The regulator sets a non-flexible price for basic water connections.
examples.zh: 监管机构为基础供水接驳设定了「不易变动的价格」。

examples.en: Our contract carries a non-flexible price for the three-year term.
examples.zh: 合同规定这三年内执行「不浮动价格」。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for non-manufacturing

examples.en: Selling and admin sit in non-manufacturing costs, away from unit costs.
examples.zh: 销售和管理费用归入「非制造成本」，不计入单位成本。

examples.en: The controller separated non-manufacturing costs for the bank's credit presentation.
examples.zh: 为向银行汇报，财务控制人单独列示了「非制造成本」。

words.enDefinition: costs incurred for indirect manufacturing

examples.en: Supervisor salaries and shop-floor cleaning fall under indirect manufacturing expenses.
examples.zh: 车间主管的工资属于「间接制造费用」。

examples.en: We chase indirect manufacturing expenses down by better shift planning.
examples.zh: 我们通过优化排班来压降「间接制造费用」。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in norm transactions

examples.en: The co-op pays growers a norm price fixed at season start.
examples.zh: 合作社按季初确定的「标准价格」向农户付款。

examples.en: Deviations from the norm price need the pricing committee's sign-off.
examples.zh: 偏离「标准价格」须经定价委员会批准。

words.enDefinition: a letter of credit facility that does not renew after it is drawn

examples.en: Each shipment draws down the non-revolving credit, once and only once.
examples.zh: 每批发货都会动用「非周转信用状」，且只能用一次。

examples.en: A non-revolving credit suits this one-off machinery purchase quite well.
examples.zh: 「非周转信用证」适合这次一次性的设备采购。

words.enDefinition: a transfer of money made for non-commercial

examples.en: Embassy fees count as a non-commercial payment under the exchange rules.
examples.zh: 按外汇规定，使馆费用属于「非贸易支付」。

examples.en: The bank asks for purpose codes on every non-commercial payment.
examples.zh: 银行要求每笔「非贸易支付」都注明用途代码。

words.enDefinition: money received from non-contractual

examples.en: Tips and goodwill gifts are non-contractual income for the studio.
examples.zh: 小费和人情馈赠对这家工作室来说是「非契约收入」。

examples.en: The trust always records non-contractual income from anonymous donors separately.
examples.zh: 信托机构把捐赠人的「非契约收益」单独记账。

words.enDefinition: items related to non-cost

examples.en: Idle-capacity write-offs count as non-cost items in this pricing model.
examples.zh: 在这种定价模型中，闲置产能核销属于「非成本项目」。

examples.en: The survey flagged non-cost items buried in the materials account.
examples.zh: 检查发现材料账户中混入了「非成本项目」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of expenses

examples.en: The rent review lifted the cost of expenses per leased square metre.
examples.zh: 租金重估抬高了每平方米租用面积的「费用成本」。

examples.en: Branch managers cap the cost of expenses at six percent of sales.
examples.zh: 分行经理把「费用成本」控制在销售额的百分之六以内。

words.enDefinition: the cost of depletion assets

examples.en: Mine accountants spread the cost of depletion assets over proven reserves.
examples.zh: 矿山会计把「递耗资产成本」按已探明储量摊销。

examples.en: New surveys raised the cost of depletion assets on the books.
examples.zh: 新的勘探结果调高了账面上「递耗资产的成本」。

words.enDefinition: the effective interest cost of borrowed funds

examples.en: Refinancing the term loan halved our cost of debt almost overnight.
examples.zh: 再融资几乎一夜之间把我们的「负债成本」砍半。

examples.en: The board weighs every project against the group's cost of debt.
examples.zh: 董事会用集团「债务成本」作为每个项目的衡量标尺。

words.enDefinition: selling activity or proceeds related to cost of by-product

examples.en: Assign the cost of by-product sales from the sawdust line.
examples.zh: 把锯木屑生产线的「副产品销售成本」单独归集。

examples.en: The cost of by-product sales barely covers its own handling.
examples.zh: 「副产品销售成本」勉强够抵其自身的处理费用。

words.enDefinition: a fundamental rule applied to cost matching income

examples.en: The cost matching income principle pairs each expense with the revenue it earns.
examples.zh: 「成本配合收益的原则」要求每项费用与其带来的收入相配比。

examples.en: Auditors test whether our accruals follow the cost matching income principle.
examples.zh: 审计师检验我们的应计项目是否符合「成本配合收益原则」。

words.enDefinition: the cost attributable to occupying floor space

examples.en: Rent, rates, and cleaning make up the cost of floor space per shelf.
examples.zh: 租金、税费和清洁费构成每米货架的「占用土地面积成本」。

examples.en: We cut the cost of floor space by stacking higher, not wider.
examples.zh: 我们靠加高层高而不是拓宽店面来降低「占用面积成本」。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in check transactions

examples.en: The board sets a check price below which sales need approval.
examples.zh: 委员会设定了一道「最低价格」，低于此价销售须审批。

examples.en: Nobody quotes the check price without the sales director's nod.
examples.zh: 没有销售总监点头，谁也不能按「最低价格」报价。

words.enDefinition: an index measuring export prices

examples.en: The index of export prices climbed for the sixth straight month.
examples.zh: 「出口价格指数」连续第六个月上涨。

examples.en: A falling index of export prices squeezes plantation margins every quarter.
examples.zh: 「出口价格指数」下滑，挤压了种植园的利润。

collocations: calculate the index of export prices
compare the index of export prices
reduce the index of export prices

words.enDefinition: an index measuring producers' shipment

examples.en: The index of producers' shipment rose two points after the port reopened.
examples.zh: 港口复航后，「生产者交货指数」上升了两个点。

examples.en: Statists publish the index of producers' shipment with a month's lag.
examples.zh: 统计部门发布的「生产者交货指数」滞后一个月。

collocations: confirm the index of producers' shipment
delay the index of producers' shipment
reroute the index of producers' shipment

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for incremental program

examples.en: Incremental program costs for the loyalty scheme run near eighty thousand a year.
examples.zh: 会员计划每年产生的「增加项目成本」接近八万元。

examples.en: Approval hinges on whether incremental program costs stay under savings.
examples.zh: 能否获批取决于「增加项目成本」是否低于节约额。

words.enDefinition: an account in which overhead costs are accumulated before being allocated to cost objects

examples.en: Machine-hours drive the size of the maintenance cost pool across the workshop.
examples.zh: 在车间里，机器工时驱动着维修「成本库」的归集。

examples.en: We apportion the marketing cost pool to each product line quarterly.
examples.zh: 我们每季度把营销「成本池」分摊到各条产品线。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for incremental

examples.en: Accept the bulk order only if it covers its incremental costs.
examples.zh: 只有当大订单能覆盖「增量成本」时才接单。

examples.en: Incremental costs of the night shift include transport and premium pay.
examples.zh: 夜班的「增量成本」包括交通补贴和加班费。

words.enDefinition: the cost of maintaining a basic standard of living

examples.en: The wage floor anchors on the cost of subsistence for a family of four.
examples.zh: 工资下限以四口之家的「生存费用」为锚。

examples.en: Rural rents barely register in the city's cost of subsistence survey.
examples.zh: 在农村，房租在「生活费」调查中几乎不占分量。

words.enDefinition: the cost of transportation

examples.en: Freight reform halved the cost of transportation for grain growers here.
examples.zh: 运费改革使粮食的「运输成本」减半。

examples.en: The cost of transportation decides whether the mine stays open.
examples.zh: 「运输成本」的高低决定这座矿山是否继续开采。

words.enDefinition: the cost of upkeep

examples.en: The cost of upkeep on the estate rises every spring.
examples.zh: 这片庄园的「保养成本」每年春天都在上涨。

examples.en: Buyers rarely price in the long-run cost of upkeep for machinery.
examples.zh: 买家很少把设备的长期「保养成本」算进价格。

words.enDefinition: the cost of labor turnover

examples.en: Exit interviews put the cost of labor turnover near forty thousand per leaver.
examples.zh: 离职面谈显示，每走一人，其「员工流动成本」约四万元。

examples.en: Better rosters lowered the cost of labor turnover in the call centre.
examples.zh: 更合理的排班降低了呼叫中心的「员工流动成本」。

collocations: prioritise the cost of labor turnover
standardise the cost of labor turnover
monitor the cost of labor turnover

words.enDefinition: the cost of manufacture

examples.en: Automation shaved a full ten percent off the cost of manufacture.
examples.zh: 自动化使「制造成本」降低了百分之十。

examples.en: Compare the cost of manufacture at both sites before awarding the run.
examples.zh: 下达生产指令前，先比较两处工厂的「制造成本」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of material

examples.en: The cost of material per unit fell once we switched suppliers.
examples.zh: 更换供应商后，单位「原料成本」下降了。

examples.en: Hedging smooths swings in the cost of material for the mill.
examples.zh: 套期保值平抑了纺织厂「原料成本」的波动。

words.enDefinition: the cost of operation

examples.en: Fuel dominates the cost of operation for the fishing fleet.
examples.zh: 燃油占这支渔船队「营业成本」的大头。

examples.en: Leasing the forklifts trimmed the cost of operation by a fifth.
examples.zh: 改租叉车使「运营成本」下降了五分之一。

words.enDefinition: the cost of intangible

examples.en: Cap development spend as the cost of intangible, not as expense.
examples.zh: 研发支出应资本化为「无形(资产)的成本」，而不是费用化。

examples.en: The cost of intangible from the patent fights shows in amortisation.
examples.zh: 专利诉讼形成的「无形资产成本」体现在摊销中。

words.enDefinition: selling activity or proceeds related to cost of installment

examples.en: Match the cost of installment sales against each collected payment.
examples.zh: 把「分期付款销货成本」与每期收款相配比。

examples.en: The controller defers the cost of installment sales over the credit term.
examples.zh: 财务控制人把「分期付款销货成本」在信用期内递延。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in normal transactions

examples.en: The catalogue's normal price returns once the clearance week ends.
examples.zh: 清仓一周后，价目表将恢复「正常价格」。

examples.en: Anything quoted above the normal price needs regional approval first.
examples.zh: 高于「正常价格」的报价须先经大区批准。

words.enDefinition: the cost of indirect expense

examples.en: IT support is an indirect expense cost shared by all departments.
examples.zh: IT支持是各部门共担的「间接费用成本」。

examples.en: We allocate the indirect expense cost by headcount each quarter.
examples.zh: 我们每季度按人数分摊「间接费用成本」。

words.enDefinition: adjustment of amounts in line with a price index

examples.en: Rent contracts here allow indexation of prices to the CPI.
examples.zh: 这里的租约允许按CPI「指数调整价格」。

examples.en: Indexation of prices kept our revenues level with inflation last year.
examples.zh: 「按指数调整价格」使收入与通胀保持同步。

words.enDefinition: the cost of idle time

examples.en: Changeover delays added two hours of cost of idle time per shift.
examples.zh: 换型延误使每班新增两小时的「停工时间成本」。

examples.en: We log the cost of idle time whenever a machine waits on materials.
examples.zh: 只要机器等料，我们就记录「闲置时间成本」。

collocations: prioritise the cost of idle time
standardise the cost of idle time
monitor the cost of idle time

words.enDefinition: the cost of idleness

examples.en: Storm days added heavy cost of idleness to the crane fleet's books.
examples.zh: 风暴天气给吊船队的账目添上了大笔「闲置成本」。

examples.en: Managers finally priced the cost of idleness hiding behind every breakdown.
examples.zh: 管理层终于算清了每次故障背后隐藏的「窝工损失」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of possession

examples.en: Slow-turning stock raises the cost of possession through storage and insurance.
examples.zh: 滞销存货会推高仓储和保险方面的「占用成本」。

examples.en: Buying six months early doubles the cost of possession on that steel.
examples.zh: 提前半年采购会使那批钢材的「持有成本」翻倍。

words.enDefinition: the cost of production

examples.en: Subsidies hide the true cost of production from most growers.
examples.zh: 补贴让大多数种植户看不到真实的「生产成本」。

examples.en: Every price review starts from the audited cost of production.
examples.zh: 每次定价审核都从经审计的「生产成本」出发。

words.enDefinition: an indication of price used in professional practice

examples.en: The broker's letter gives only an indication of price, not a quote.
examples.zh: 经纪人的信函只给出了「价格的迹象」，并非正式报价。

examples.en: Buyers treat early whispers as a rough indication of price direction.
examples.zh: 买方把风闻的行情当作「价格走向」的大致征兆。

words.enDefinition: export activity related to nationalized

examples.en: After the decree, coffee trading became a nationalized export monopoly.
examples.zh: 法令颁布后，咖啡贸易变成了「出口贸易国有化」的专营。

examples.en: Growers resented the nationalized export board's fixed pricing during drought years.
examples.zh: 种植户对「出口国有化」机构的定价颇为不满。

words.enDefinition: revenue arising from national

examples.en: Tourism now supplies a fifth of the island's national revenue.
examples.zh: 旅游业目前贡献了该岛「国民收入」的五分之一。

examples.en: Tax reform aimed to widen national revenue without raising rates.
examples.zh: 税改旨在不提高税率的情况下扩大「国民收入」。

words.enDefinition: a costing approach used for multiple

examples.en: The group applies multiple costing across its four product families.
examples.zh: 集团对四大产品族并行采用「复合成本计算」。

examples.en: Multiple costing blends job and process methods where lines overlap.
examples.zh: 在工序交叉之处，「复合成本计算」融合了分批法与分步法。

words.enDefinition: a letter of credit payable against clean documents (without full shipping-document sets)

examples.en: A clean payment credit asks only for the draft, no shipping documents.
examples.zh: 「光票付款信用证」只要求提交汇票，无需货运单据。

examples.en: The clean payment credit suits trusted buyers with long histories.
examples.zh: 「光票信用证」适合往来多年、彼此信任的买家。

words.enDefinition: a cost incurred for corporation bonds issuing

examples.en: Legal and printing fees form the corporation bonds issuing expense.
examples.zh: 法律和印制费用构成「公司债发行费用」。

examples.en: We amortise the corporation bonds issuing expense over the ten-year term.
examples.zh: 我们把「公司债发行费用」在十年期限内摊销。

collocations: calculate the corporation bonds issuing expense
compare the corporation bonds issuing expense
interpret the corporation bonds issuing expense

words.enDefinition: the cost of corporation bonds issuing

examples.en: The underwriting spread is the largest single corporation bonds issuing cost.
examples.zh: 承销差价是「公司债发行成本」中最大的一块。

examples.en: Better market timing trimmed the corporation bonds issuing cost this year.
examples.zh: 发行时机的把握使今年「公司债发行成本」有所下降。

collocations: calculate the corporation bonds issuing cost
compare the corporation bonds issuing cost
interpret the corporation bonds issuing cost

words.enDefinition: profits arising from corporation

examples.en: Corporation profits rebounded sharply once the refinery restarted full operations.
examples.zh: 炼油厂复工后，「公司利润」随之回升。

examples.en: Half of corporation profits flow straight into the reinvestment pool.
examples.zh: 「公司利润」的一半直接流入再投资资金池。

words.enDefinition: a class of trade used in professional practice

examples.en: Rebates vary by class of trade, from chains to corner shops.
examples.zh: 返利按「客户类别」而不同，连锁店和街角小店各有标准。

examples.en: Each class of trade carries its own credit terms in our system.
examples.zh: 在我们的系统里，每个「商业等级」都有各自的信用条件。

words.enDefinition: collateral required to open a futures or leveraged position

examples.en: Traders post initial margin before the first contract is matched.
examples.zh: 交易者在第一笔合约撮合前须缴纳「初始保证金」。

examples.en: The exchange raised initial margin on coffee futures by two points.
examples.zh: 交易所把咖啡期货的「初始保证金」上调了两个百分点。

words.enDefinition: a net sales to inventory used in professional practice

examples.en: A falling net sales to inventory ratio warns of overstocked shelves.
examples.zh: 「净销售额与库存比例」下降，预示着货架积压。

examples.en: We track net sales to inventory monthly across all four depots.
examples.zh: 我们按月跟踪四个仓库的「净销售额与库存比例」。

words.enDefinition: distribution of cost

examples.en: The model runs a cost distribution across regions every quarter.
examples.zh: 模型每季度在各区域之间进行一次「成本分配」。

examples.en: Manuals spell out the cost distribution keys for shared services.
examples.zh: 手册明确规定了共享服务的「成本分配」标准。

words.enDefinition: total debt less offsets, showing net amounts owed

examples.en: Selling the cruise ship cut net indebtedness below one billion.
examples.zh: 出售邮轮使「净负债」降到十亿以下。

examples.en: Loan covenants cap net indebtedness at three times annual EBITDA.
examples.zh: 债务契约把「净负债」限定在年EBITDA的三倍以内。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage cost for budgetary

examples.en: Standard rates give the cost for budgetary control at each plant.
examples.zh: 标准费率为各工厂提供「预算控制用成本」。

examples.en: Finance recalibrates the cost for budgetary control every single October.
examples.zh: 财务部门每年十月重新校定「预算控制用成本」。

collocations: improve the cost for budgetary control
measure the cost for budgetary control
benchmark the cost for budgetary control

words.enDefinition: the movement of money or resources in cost

examples.en: Barcode scanning makes the cost flow visible from dock to dispatch.
examples.zh: 条码扫描让从卸货到发运的「成本流动」清晰可见。

examples.en: LIFO changes alter reported margins without touching physical cost flow.
examples.zh: 改用后进先出法会改变账面毛利，但「成本流转」实际未变。

words.enDefinition: fluctuation in cost

examples.en: Fuel is the main driver of cost fluctuation on our shipping lanes.
examples.zh: 燃油是我们航线「成本变动」的主要推手。

examples.en: Quarterly contracts dampen cost fluctuation for both buyers and sellers.
examples.zh: 季度合同缓冲了双方的「成本波动」。

words.enDefinition: amounts added to cost in a cost build-up

examples.en: Testing rework appears as cost additions on the job card.
examples.zh: 返工复检在工单上表现为「成本加项」。

examples.en: Review every entry in cost additions before the month-end close.
examples.zh: 月末结账前要复核每一笔「成本加项」。

words.enDefinition: an absorption for cost

examples.en: Full capacity runs improve cost absorption across the moulding shop.
examples.zh: 满负荷运转改善了模塑车间的「成本归集」。

examples.en: Weak demand means poor cost absorption and higher unit overheads.
examples.zh: 需求疲软意味着「成本吸收」不佳，单位间接费用随之升高。

words.enDefinition: a cost incurred for cost department

examples.en: Salaries of the costing team sit in cost department expense.
examples.zh: 成本核算团队的工资记在「成本部门费用」里。

examples.en: Auditors questioned the spike in cost department expense last autumn.
examples.zh: 审计人员质疑去年秋天「成本部门费用」的激增。

words.enDefinition: an application for cost

examples.en: Machine-hours remain the fairest basis of cost application in this shop.
examples.zh: 机器工时仍是这里最合理的「成本分配」依据。

examples.en: The cost application sheet accompanies every production order we release.
examples.zh: 每张生产订单都附有一份「成本分配单」。

words.enDefinition: a valuation approach based on cost to reproduce or replace

examples.en: Valuers favour the cost approach for this highly specialised chemical plant.
examples.zh: 评估师对这座专用厂房倾向于采用「成本计算法」。

examples.en: Under the cost approach, replacement value sets the valuation floor here.
examples.zh: 按照「成本法」，重置价值构成了估值的下限。

words.enDefinition: a line of cost budget

examples.en: Training lost its cost budget line in the June revision.
examples.zh: 在六月修订中，培训的「成本预算线」被删掉了。

examples.en: Each cost budget line in the pack names one accountable manager.
examples.zh: 每条「成本预算线」都指定一名负责经理。

words.enDefinition: a cost budget presented in diagram form

examples.en: The board pack presents the cost budget in diagrams this year.
examples.zh: 今年的董事会材料用图表呈现「成本预算」。

examples.en: Cost budget in diagrams makes variances obvious at a glance.
examples.zh: 用图表表示「成本预算」，差异一目了然。

words.enDefinition: a detailed examination of cost behavior

examples.en: A fresh cost behavior analysis showed utilities stay semi-variable here.
examples.zh: 「成本习性分析」表明水电费属于半变动成本。

examples.en: Before pricing the season, run a fresh cost behavior analysis.
examples.zh: 给本季定价之前，先做一次新的「成本习性分析」。

words.enDefinition: the way costs change with activity level (fixed, variable, or mixed)

examples.en: Understanding cost behavior separates fixed commitments from flexible discretionary spend.
examples.zh: 理解「成本性态」能区分刚性支出与弹性支出。

examples.en: Our tutor explained cost behavior with the bakery's oven example.
examples.zh: 老师用面包坊的烤炉例子讲解「成本习性」。

words.enDefinition: bidding conducted as negotiated

examples.en: Negotiated bidding allowed the ministry to pick two finalists directly.
examples.zh: 「谈判招标」让部委直接圈定了两家入围企业。

examples.en: Critics say negotiated bidding always favours incumbents over hungry newcomers.
examples.zh: 批评者认为「谈判招标」偏袒在位企业，不利于新来者。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for inescapable

examples.en: Rates and licences are inescapable costs even in a shutdown year.
examples.zh: 即使全年停工，税费和牌照费也是「不可避免的成本」。

examples.en: The closure study carefully separated inescapable costs from real savings.
examples.zh: 关停测算把「不可避免的成本」与可节约项分开比较。

words.enDefinition: a center for cost

examples.en: Each regional office runs as its own cost center since April.
examples.zh: 自四月起，每个区域办公室都作为独立的「成本中心」运作。

examples.en: Charge every visitor's stay to the host department's cost center.
examples.zh: 把来访者的接待费用记入接待方「成本中心」。

words.enDefinition: a process used to manage and limit costs within set targets

examples.en: Weekly variance meetings anchor our cost control on the shop floor.
examples.zh: 每周的差异分析例会是我们车间「成本控制」的抓手。

examples.en: Good cost control saved the project when timber prices spiked.
examples.zh: 木材价格飙升时，正是良好的「成本控制」救了这个项目。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for contract stipulated

examples.en: Delivery bonuses vanish if the contract stipulated price is exceeded.
examples.zh: 一旦超过「合同规定价格」，交付奖励就没了。

examples.en: The contract stipulated price adjusts only with official steel indexes.
examples.zh: 「合同规定价格」只随官方钢材指数调整。

words.enDefinition: a fee or commission paid in respect of confirmation

examples.en: The advising bank quoted a confirmation commission of one and a half percent.
examples.zh: 通知行报出的「保兑手续费」是百分之一点五。

examples.en: We skipped the confirmation commission since the issuing bank is solid.
examples.zh: 开证行实力雄厚，我们省掉了「保兑手续费」。

words.enDefinition: a system for conduct business

examples.en: Their conduct business system documents every approval chain in writing.
examples.zh: 他们的「经营企业系统」把每条审批链都记录在案。

examples.en: The franchise's conduct business system binds every single outlet legally.
examples.zh: 这套「经营企业系统」约束着每一家加盟店。

words.enDefinition: a charge or stake related to liability with

examples.en: Trade creditors rank as liability with interest only after default notices.
examples.zh: 只有收到违约通知后，应付账款才转为「有息负债」。

examples.en: The balance sheet splits liability with interest from trade payables.
examples.zh: 资产负债表把「有息负债」与应付账款分开列示。

words.enDefinition: money received from contract area

examples.en: Contract area income from Block 7 funds the seismic campaign.
examples.zh: 七号区块的「合同区收益」为地震勘探提供资金。

examples.en: The partners share contract area income after royalty deductions each year.
examples.zh: 扣除矿区使用费后，合作各方分享「合同区收益」。

words.zhGloss: 已付合同(契约)存款(保证金)
words.enDefinition: contract deposit that has been paid
acceptedZhAnswers: 已付合同(契约)存款(保证金)

examples.en: Contract deposit paid on the crane lease shows as a receivable.
examples.zh: 履约时支付的起重机租赁「合同保证金」列作应收款项。

examples.en: The ledger keeps contract deposit paid separate from customer advances.
examples.zh: 账簿把「已付合同保证金」与预付款分账管理。

words.zhGloss: 已收合同(契约)存款(保证金)
words.enDefinition: contract deposit that has been received
acceptedZhAnswers: 已收合同(契约)存款(保证金)

examples.en: We recognise contract deposit received only when the cash lands.
examples.zh: 只有现金到账，我们才确认「已收合同(契约)保证金」。

examples.en: Contract deposit received stays untouched in escrow until delivery acceptance.
examples.zh: 「已收合同保证金」在验收交付前不得动用。

words.enDefinition: a carrier operating under contract arrangements

examples.en: A contract carrier runs our refrigerated routes on fixed schedules.
examples.zh: 一家「合同承运人」按固定班期运营我们的冷藏线路。

examples.en: Unlike common carriers, a contract carrier serves named clients only.
examples.zh: 与公共承运人不同，「合同承运人」只服务指定客户。

words.enDefinition: a contract of service used in professional practice

examples.en: Technicians sign a contract of service with the plant, not the agency.
examples.zh: 技师与工厂而非劳务公司签订「劳务合同」。

examples.en: Benefits under the contract of service start after probation ends.
examples.zh: 「劳务合同」约定的福利自试用期满后生效。

words.enDefinition: a contract under which goods or assets are purchased

examples.en: The refinery signed a contract for purchase of twelve crude cargoes.
examples.zh: 炼油厂签订了一份采购十二船原油的「购货合同」。

examples.en: A contract for purchase requires the seller's warranty on origin.
examples.zh: 「购货合同」要求卖方对货物原产地作出保证。

words.enDefinition: a contract requiring delivery at a future date

examples.en: Grain buyers hedge with a contract of future delivery each season.
examples.zh: 粮商每季都用「远期交货合同」进行套期保值。

examples.en: The contract of future delivery fixes tonnage but not freight.
examples.zh: 这份「远期交货合同」锁定了吨位，但运费另议。

collocations: confirm the contract of future delivery
delay the contract of future delivery
reroute the contract of future delivery

words.enDefinition: a market for contract

examples.en: Futures for grain trade on the designated contract market in Chicago.
examples.zh: 期货在芝加哥的指定「合约市场」交易。

examples.en: The contract market sets daily price limits for every month.
examples.zh: 「合约市场」为每个月份合约设定每日涨跌停板。

words.enDefinition: a contract for the carriage of goods by ship

examples.en: The smelter fixed a contract of affreightment for twenty cargoes.
examples.zh: 冶炼厂签订了一份承运二十船货的「包运合同」。

examples.en: A contract of affreightment promises shipping capacity, not named vessels.
examples.zh: 「包运合同」约定的是运力，而非指定船舶。

words.enDefinition: a contract for transporting goods or passengers

examples.en: Every pallet moves under the contract of carriage printed on the waybill.
examples.zh: 每个托盘货都按运单上印明的「运输合同」承运。

examples.en: The contract of carriage limits liability to two units per kilogram.
examples.zh: 「运输合同」把赔偿责任限定为每公斤两个计算单位。

words.enDefinition: an explanatory disclosure related to contract

examples.en: The broker's contract note arrived the morning after the deal.
examples.zh: 成交次日一早，经纪人的「买卖合同书」就到了。

examples.en: Check the contract note against your original instruction before settling.
examples.zh: 结算前，请把「成交单」与你的委托单核对。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in listed transactions

examples.en: The listed price rarely survives the first round of negotiation.
examples.zh: 「挂牌价格」很少能在第一轮谈判后保持原样。

examples.en: Compare the listed price with the achieved price on every let.
examples.zh: 每一单都要把「挂牌价」与成交价进行比较。

words.enDefinition: revenue arising from contractual

examples.en: Contractual revenue from the three-year licence covers all server costs.
examples.zh: 三年期许可带来的「合同收益」足以覆盖服务器成本。

examples.en: Analysts value the backlog's contractual revenue at ten times earnings.
examples.zh: 分析师按十倍估值看待存量订单的「合同收入」。

words.enDefinition: a transfer of money made for contractual

examples.en: A contractual payment falls due on the tenth of each month.
examples.zh: 每月十日有一笔「合约付款」到期。

examples.en: Missing even one contractual payment voids the maintenance warranty entirely.
examples.zh: 漏付一期「合约付款」将使维修保修失效。

words.enDefinition: an obligation for contractual

examples.en: Storms excuse neither party from a contractual obligation to deliver.
examples.zh: 风暴不能免除任何一方的交货「合同义务」。

examples.en: Legal reviewed every contractual obligation before the signing ceremony began.
examples.zh: 签字仪式之前，法务逐条审阅了每项「合同责任」。

words.enDefinition: the sequence of stages or a production line used to make goods

examples.en: The second line of production opened for export orders only.
examples.zh: 第二条「生产线」专为出口订单启用。

examples.en: Bottlenecks on the filling line of production slowed everything downstream.
examples.zh: 灌装「生产线」上的瓶颈拖慢了整个进度。

words.enDefinition: budgeting for continuous

examples.en: Continuous budgeting keeps a rolling twelve-month plan on the table.
examples.zh: 「连续编制预算」让十二个月的滚动计划始终在线。

examples.en: With continuous budgeting, each month adds a fresh forecast month.
examples.zh: 采用「连续编制预算」，每月都会新增一个预测月份。

words.enDefinition: the cost of continuing

examples.en: Support is a continuing cost, not a one-off project spend.
examples.zh: 技术支持属于「持续成本」，而非一次性项目支出。

examples.en: Before acquiring the depot, price its continuing cost of upkeep.
examples.zh: 收购仓库之前，先算清它的「持续保养成本」。

words.enDefinition: the makeup or build-up of a cost figure

examples.en: The walkthrough explained the construction of cost for each dish.
examples.zh: 讲解会说明了每道菜的「成本构成」。

examples.en: Procurement disputes often trace back to unclear construction of cost.
examples.zh: 采购纠纷的根源往往是「成本构成」不清晰。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning construction

examples.en: The stadium's construction contract requires full completion before the tournament.
examples.zh: 体育场的「施工合同」要求在锦标赛前竣工。

examples.en: Delays under the construction contract automatically trigger liquidated damages payments.
examples.zh: 「施工合同」项下的延误将触发违约赔偿金。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for construction

examples.en: Rainy-season overtime blew the construction budget for the new bridge.
examples.zh: 雨季加班使大桥的「基建预算」超支了。

examples.en: The council approved a construction budget of twelve million dollars.
examples.zh: 议会批准了一千二百万元的「基建预算」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of laid down

examples.en: Compare the laid down cost per tonne across the two ports.
examples.zh: 比较两个港口每吨货物的「到岸成本」。

examples.en: The inland depot beat the coastal one on laid down cost.
examples.zh: 内陆库在「到岸成本」上胜过了沿海库。

words.enDefinition: the cost of constant

examples.en: Patrol fees stay a constant cost whatever the season's catch.
examples.zh: 无论渔获多少，巡护费都是一笔「不变成本」。

examples.en: Treat the ground rent as constant cost in the cash plan.
examples.zh: 在现金计划中把地租视作「固定不变成本」。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for joint survey

examples.en: Partners share joint survey costs for the offshore block equally.
examples.zh: 合作各方平摊海上区块的「联合物探费用」。

examples.en: Delaying joint survey costs pushed the appraisal work into next year.
examples.zh: 推迟「联合物探费用」支出使评估工作延至明年。

words.enDefinition: arbitration of labour

examples.en: The port dispute went to labour arbitration last Tuesday afternoon.
examples.zh: 港口纠纷于上周二提交「劳工争议仲裁」。

examples.en: Both unions accepted labour arbitration rather than calling a strike.
examples.zh: 两家工会都接受「劳工仲裁」，而不是罢工。

words.enDefinition: the cost of abandonment

examples.en: Regulators demand a bond covering the mine's future abandonment cost.
examples.zh: 监管机构要求就矿山的「弃置成本」缴纳保证金。

examples.en: Abandonment cost for the old wells runs into eight figures.
examples.zh: 这些油井的「弃置成本」高达八位数。

words.enDefinition: management of contingency

examples.en: Contingency management kept the launch alive through two supplier failures.
examples.zh: 凭着「灵活应变管理」，发布会挺过了两次供应商违约。

examples.en: The airport credits contingency management for the calm storm response.
examples.zh: 机场把风暴期间的从容应对归功于「应急管理」。

words.enDefinition: a market for consumer

examples.en: The consumer market for oat drinks doubled in three years.
examples.zh: 燕麦饮品的「消费者市场」三年间翻了一番。

examples.en: Rural buyers remain the fastest-growing segment of the consumer market.
examples.zh: 农村买主仍是增长最快的「消费者市场」板块。

words.enDefinition: prices charged in consumer transactions

examples.en: Consumer prices for cooking oil eased after the bumper harvest.
examples.zh: 收成之后，食用油的「消费品价格」有所回落。

examples.en: Shoppers track consumer prices weekly on a free comparison app.
examples.zh: 购物者每周都在比价应用上追踪「消费品价格」。

words.enDefinition: finance related to consumer

examples.en: Appliance sales ride on consumer finance plans from the retailer.
examples.zh: 家电销售靠零售商提供的「消费金融」分期方案带动。

examples.en: Regulators tightened consumer finance rules for online payday loan firms.
examples.zh: 监管机构收紧了针对发薪日贷款的「消费信贷」规则。

words.enDefinition: an order document or instruction for job production

examples.en: Each job production order lists its tooling and inspection points.
examples.zh: 每张「批量生产订货单」都列明工装和检验点。

examples.en: The planner released the job production order for the turbine housings.
examples.zh: 计划员为涡轮机机壳下达了「批量生产订单」。

words.enDefinition: an order related to job

examples.en: Cutters only start once the job order carries a signature.
examples.zh: 只有「工作通知单」签了字，裁剪工才能开工。

examples.en: One job order covers the fifty pump bodies for the mine.
examples.zh: 一张「分批工作通知单」涵盖为矿山生产的五十个泵体。

words.enDefinition: the output or activity level at which total cost is minimised

examples.en: Engineers located the least cost point between manual and robotic welding.
examples.zh: 工程师找到了手工焊与机器人焊之间的「最小成本点」。

examples.en: The least cost point shifts whenever energy tariffs move significantly.
examples.zh: 电价一变，「最小成本点」的位置也随之移动。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for job

examples.en: Site managers submit job costs before the Friday payroll run.
examples.zh: 工地主管要在周五发薪前提交「作业成本」报表。

examples.en: Job costs for the refit already exceed the original quotation.
examples.zh: 这次改装的「作业成本」已超过报价。

words.enDefinition: the joint cost incurred in producing goods

examples.en: Sawdust and planks share the joint cost of production at the mill.
examples.zh: 锯末和板材在锯木厂共同分摊「联合生产成本」。

examples.en: Accountants split the joint cost of production by sales value.
examples.zh: 会计按销售价值分摊「联合生产成本」。

words.enDefinition: management of joint

examples.en: The two families still run the vineyard under joint management.
examples.zh: 两个家族以「联合经营」的方式管理葡萄园。

examples.en: Joint management of the container terminal eased the customs bottlenecks.
examples.zh: 对码头实行「联合管理」缓解了海关瓶颈。

words.enDefinition: a business combination in which one company gains control of another by purchasing it

examples.en: Consolidation by purchase left goodwill of two million on the books.
examples.zh: 「购买合并」在账面上留下了两百万元的商誉。

examples.en: Under consolidation by purchase, the subsidiary's assets were fully revalued.
examples.zh: 在「购买合并」下，子公司的资产进行了重新计价。

words.enDefinition: manufacture of job-lot

examples.en: Job-lot manufacture suits the switchgear shop better than line flow.
examples.zh: 对开关柜车间来说，「分批生产」比流水线更合适。

examples.en: Job-lot manufacture keeps tooling changes frequent but finished stock low.
examples.zh: 「分批生产」让换模频繁，但库存很低。

words.enDefinition: a market for jobber

examples.en: Cocoa moves through the jobber market before reaching the grinders.
examples.zh: 可可豆先经过「分包市场」流转，才到达研磨厂商。

examples.en: Brokers quote the jobber market over the phone each morning.
examples.zh: 经纪人每天早上通过电话报出「中间商市场」行情。

words.enDefinition: a joint cost of operation used in professional practice

examples.en: Rail and port charges form the joint cost of operation for exports.
examples.zh: 铁路和港口费用构成出口的「联合经营成本」。

examples.en: Sharing warehouses reduced the joint cost of operation for both firms.
examples.zh: 共用仓库降低了双方「共同经营成本」。

collocations: calculate the joint cost of operation
compare the joint cost of operation
interpret the joint cost of operation

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage manual of cost

examples.en: New supervisors receive the manual of cost control on day one.
examples.zh: 新任主管入职第一天就会拿到「成本管理手册」。

examples.en: The manual of cost control spells out every approval threshold.
examples.zh: 「成本管理手册」明确了每一级审批额度。

collocations: govern the manual of cost control
escalate the manual of cost control
stabilise the manual of cost control

words.enDefinition: a business concern in manufacturing

examples.en: As a manufacturing concern, we bear tooling costs others avoid.
examples.zh: 作为「制造企业」，我们要承担别人避开的工装成本。

examples.en: Any manufacturing concern in the zone qualifies for the grant.
examples.zh: 区内任何「制造企业」都有资格申请这笔补助。

words.enDefinition: a center for manufacturing

examples.en: Guangzhou has grown into a manufacturing center for consumer electronics.
examples.zh: 广州已发展成为消费电子的「制造中心」。

examples.en: The old textile manufacturing center now hosts independent design studios.
examples.zh: 昔日的纺织「制造中心」如今聚集着设计工作室。

words.enDefinition: capacity for manufacturing

examples.en: New assembly lines added thirty percent manufacturing capacity this spring.
examples.zh: 今年春天，新产线使「制造能力」提升了百分之三十。

examples.en: Manufacturing capacity sits idle every August when workers take leave.
examples.zh: 每年八月工人休假，「制造产能」随之闲置。

words.enDefinition: manufacturing overhead or burden costs

examples.en: Depreciation of the furnaces dominates the manufacturing burden in this foundry.
examples.zh: 在这家铸造厂，折旧占「制造费用」的大头。

examples.en: Energy surcharges pushed the manufacturing burden up seven points this year.
examples.zh: 能源附加费使「制造费用」上升了七个百分点。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for manufacturing

examples.en: The manufacturing budget assumes a scrap rate below four percent.
examples.zh: 「生产预算」假定废品率低于百分之四。

examples.en: Plant managers defend their manufacturing budget before the board every October.
examples.zh: 各厂厂长每年十月都要为「生产预算」进行答辩。

words.enDefinition: a branch handling manufacturers' sales

examples.en: The manufacturers' sales branch in Osaka quotes directly for Kansai.
examples.zh: 大阪的「制造厂所属销售机构」直接负责关西报价。

examples.en: Orders route through the manufacturers' sales branch rather than distributors.
examples.zh: 订单须经「制造厂销售分支机构」，而非经销商。

words.enDefinition: an order related to manufacture

examples.en: Production begins only when the manufacture order carries both countersignatures.
examples.zh: 「制造定单」会签之后才能开工。

examples.en: The scheduler merges two manufacture orders to save costly changeovers.
examples.zh: 排程员把两张「制造定单」合并，以减少换型。

words.enDefinition: an agent acting for manufacturer's

examples.en: A manufacturer's agent covers three provinces for our industrial pumps.
examples.zh: 一位「厂商代理人」负责我们水泵在三个省的销售。

examples.en: The manufacturer's agent earns commission only on orders actually delivered.
examples.zh: 这位「厂商代理」只对已交付订单计提佣金。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in intracompany transactions

examples.en: The intracompany price for finished lenses mirrors current external quotes.
examples.zh: 成品镜片的「公司内部价格」参照外部报价制定。

examples.en: Auditors test the intracompany price against the arm's-length rule annually.
examples.zh: 审计师按公平交易原则检验「公司内部价格」。

words.zhGloss: 公司内部调拨(转让)价格
words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for intra-company transfer
acceptedZhAnswers: 公司内部调拨(转让)价格

examples.en: The intra-company transfer price for chips follows a cost-plus formula.
examples.zh: 芯片的「公司内部调拨价格」按成本加成公式确定。

examples.en: Tax inspectors challenged the intra-company transfer price set for engines.
examples.zh: 税务稽查员对发动机的「公司内部转让价格」提出质疑。

words.enDefinition: the cost of shared resources

examples.en: Security for the whole estate is a common cost shared by tenants.
examples.zh: 整个园区的安保是租户分摊的「共同成本」。

examples.en: We apportion the common cost of the canteen by headcount.
examples.zh: 我们按人数分摊食堂的「共同成本」。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in intracorporate transactions

examples.en: Group policy fixes one intracorporate price per component family worldwide.
examples.zh: 集团政策为每个零部件系列定一个「公司内部价格」。

examples.en: The intracorporate price list is refreshed every January by treasury.
examples.zh: 「公司内部价格表」每年一月更新。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in commodity transactions

examples.en: Hedging contracts steadied the commodity price we pay for aluminium.
examples.zh: 套期保值稳定了我们采购铝锭的「商品价格」。

examples.en: The commodity price cycle turned just before the harvest sold.
examples.zh: 收成尚未卖出，「商品价格」周期已见顶回落。

words.enDefinition: a margin deposit lodged when opening a letter of credit

examples.en: The bank holds a marginal deposit before issuing the letter of credit.
examples.zh: 开立信用证之前，银行要收取一笔「保证金存款」。

examples.en: A marginal deposit of thirty percent secures the import credit.
examples.zh: 百分之三十的「保证金存款」担保了这笔进口信用证。

words.enDefinition: a basic or limited letter-of-credit facility used in trade finance

examples.en: The branch works on a marginal credit of one hundred thousand.
examples.zh: 这家分行的业务以十万元的「定额信用证」为限。

examples.en: Export deals above the marginal credit need head-office approval first.
examples.zh: 超出「定额信用证」额度的出口须报总部批准。

words.enDefinition: a costing approach used for marginal

examples.en: Under marginal costing, only variable costs price the export deal.
examples.zh: 按「边际成本计算」，出口订单定价只计变动成本。

examples.en: Marginal costing shows the spare weekend shift almost pays for itself.
examples.zh: 「边际成本计算」显示，周末闲置班次几乎可以自给自足。

words.enDefinition: the marginal cost incurred in producing goods

examples.en: The marginal cost of production for one extra barrel stays under twenty dollars.
examples.zh: 多产一桶油的「边际生产成本」仍低于二十美元。

examples.en: Price the export offer just above the marginal cost of production.
examples.zh: 出口报价只要略高于「生产的边际成本」即可接受。

words.enDefinition: selling activity or proceeds related to margin on

examples.en: Our margin on sales widened nicely after the packaging redesign.
examples.zh: 包装改版之后，我们的「销售毛利」有所扩大。

examples.en: The franchisor caps the margin on sales at twenty-five percent.
examples.zh: 特许方把「销售毛利」上限定为百分之二十五。
